english: machine (such as a car) that is used to carry things
primaryExample: Because the mountain road was narrow, we chose a smaller vehicle that could turn around more easily.
primaryTranslation: 因为山路狭窄，我们选了一辆更容易掉头的小型车辆。

english: a person who is trained to gain knowledge by making predictions, testing them, and developing theories
primaryExample: The scientist repeated the experiment several times before she was confident that the results were reliable.
primaryTranslation: 这位科学家多次重复实验后，才确信结果可靠。

english: way to get from one place to another place
primaryExample: We took a different route to the station because the main bridge was closed for repairs.
primaryTranslation: 由于主桥封闭维修，我们换了一条路线去车站。

english: to join two or more things together to limit their freedom
primaryExample: They used strong rope to bind the wooden poles together before lifting the frame into position.
primaryTranslation: 他们先用结实的绳子把木杆绑在一起，再把框架抬到位。

english: to be a member of a particular group and feel welcomed
primaryExample: Although she had recently joined the club, everyone made her feel that she really did belong there.
primaryTranslation: 虽然她刚加入俱乐部，大家却都让她觉得自己真正属于这里。

english: the particular quality of food or drink that can be sensed by a person's mouth
primaryExample: The soup had a much richer taste after we added fresh herbs and cooked it slowly.
primaryTranslation: 加入新鲜香草并慢慢熬煮后，这道汤的味道浓郁了许多。

english: the time from when the sun goes down on this day to when it comes up the following morning
primaryExample: We should finish packing tonight so that we can leave for the airport without rushing tomorrow morning.
primaryTranslation: 我们今晚应该收拾好行李，这样明早就能从容地去机场。

english: style of dress or activity popular at some time
primaryExample: She follows fashion closely, but she prefers clothes that remain useful long after a particular trend has passed.
primaryTranslation: 她密切关注时尚，但更喜欢某种潮流过后仍然实用的衣服。

english: possibility of getting hurt, damaged, or killed
primaryExample: The guide explained the danger of walking near the cliff, especially when the path was wet.
primaryTranslation: 导游解释了靠近悬崖行走的危险，尤其是在小路湿滑的时候。

english: a weapon designed to break apart very suddenly and violently
primaryExample: The museum displayed a damaged bomb case to explain how the town had experienced the war.
primaryTranslation: 博物馆展示了一个受损的炸弹外壳，用来说明这座城镇在战争中的遭遇。

english: large group of soldiers organized to fight in wars
primaryExample: After leaving the army, my uncle trained as an engineer and helped build bridges in remote areas.
primaryTranslation: 离开军队后，我叔叔接受了工程师培训，帮助偏远地区修建桥梁。

english: involving the chance of hurt or damage; risky
primaryExample: Cycling along that road can be dangerous because drivers cannot see clearly around the sharp bend.
primaryTranslation: 在那条路上骑车可能很危险，因为司机无法看清急弯另一侧的情况。

english: to reduce the size, amount, or number of something
primaryExample: We hope the new bus service will decrease the number of cars entering the city centre each morning.
primaryTranslation: 我们希望新的公交服务能减少每天早晨进入市中心的汽车数量。

english: to cause pain, damage, or injury
primaryExample: He did not mean to hurt her feelings, but his careless comment made her feel unwelcome.
primaryTranslation: 他并不想伤害她的感情，但他那句随意的话让她觉得自己不受欢迎。

english: group chosen to make decisions about something
primaryExample: The local council asked residents for their opinions before deciding where to build the new sports centre.
primaryTranslation: 地方委员会在决定新体育中心的选址之前，征求了居民的意见。

english: a person whose job is to correct and make changes to the contents of a book or magazine
primaryExample: The editor suggested a clearer opening paragraph so that readers would understand the purpose of the article immediately.
primaryTranslation: 编辑建议把开头一段写得更清楚，让读者马上理解文章的目的。

english: in the manner that is usual or ordinary
primaryExample: We normally walk to school, although we take the bus when the weather is particularly wet or cold.
primaryTranslation: 我们通常步行上学，不过遇到特别阴雨或寒冷的天气就乘公交车。

english: the ability to see
primaryExample: Her grandfather's sight had become weaker, so she bought him books with larger print that were easier to read.
primaryTranslation: 她祖父的视力变差了，于是她给他买了更容易阅读的大字版书籍。

english: to create or be produced or bring into existence
primaryExample: The roof panels generate enough electricity to power the building during most of the summer, reducing its energy costs.
primaryTranslation: 屋顶上的面板在夏季大部分时间能产生足够的电力供大楼使用，从而降低能源费用。

english: something given to another for a reason; present
primaryExample: We chose a small handmade gift that would remind our host of the enjoyable week we had spent together.
primaryTranslation: 我们选了一件手工制作的小礼物，好让主人记起一起度过的愉快一周。

english: act of taking something to a person or place
primaryExample: The shop offered free delivery because the furniture was too large for us to carry home ourselves.
primaryTranslation: 商店提供免费配送，因为这些家具太大，我们无法自己搬回家。

english: to refuse to allow or accept something
primaryExample: The manager did not deny that mistakes had been made, but she promised to explain what had happened.
primaryTranslation: 经理没有否认曾出现错误，但她承诺会解释事情的经过。

english: person invited to visit or stay in someone's home
primaryExample: We asked each guest to mention any food allergies before the meal so that everyone could eat safely.
primaryTranslation: 我们请每位客人在用餐前说明食物过敏情况，以便大家安心进餐。

english: any person; anyone
primaryExample: If anybody needs help with the application form, a member of staff will be available near the entrance.
primaryTranslation: 如果有人需要填写申请表方面的帮助，入口附近会有工作人员提供协助。

english: room for sleeping usually with a bed
primaryExample: We turned the spare bedroom into a study after discovering that we both needed somewhere quiet to work.
primaryTranslation: 发现我们都需要安静的工作空间后，我们把空余的卧室改成了书房。

english: to use someone's exact words in your writing or speech
primaryExample: If you quote a sentence from another writer, remember to name the author and show where it came from.
primaryTranslation: 如果引用其他作者的句子，记得注明作者，并说明出处。

english: to rise gradually and steadily to a higher point
primaryExample: We began to climb the hill before sunrise so that we could reach the top before the heat became uncomfortable.
primaryTranslation: 我们日出前就开始爬山，希望在暑热难耐之前到达山顶。

english: in the most important ways even if not completely true
primaryExample: The two machines are basically the same, although the newer model is quieter and uses slightly less electricity.
primaryTranslation: 这两台机器基本相同，不过较新的型号更安静，耗电量也略低。

english: use of physical force to harm someone or damage something
primaryExample: The community organised a peaceful meeting to discuss how better youth services might help reduce violence in the area.
primaryTranslation: 社区组织了一场和平集会，讨论改善青少年服务如何帮助减少当地暴力事件。

english: an official who heads a government department
primaryExample: The education minister visited the school to hear how the new classrooms had changed the students' learning experience.
primaryTranslation: 教育部长到校访问，了解新教室如何改变了学生的学习体验。

english: mostly; usually; being the largest part
primaryExample: The village depends mainly on visitors in summer, so several small shops close during the quieter winter months.
primaryTranslation: 这个村庄主要依靠夏季游客，因此几家小店在较清闲的冬季会关门。

english: part of the face used for eating and talking
primaryExample: He covered his mouth when he coughed, then moved away from the crowded table to get some fresh air.
primaryTranslation: 他咳嗽时捂住嘴，然后离开拥挤的餐桌去透透气。

english: a loud or unpleasant sound
primaryExample: We moved our meeting to a smaller room because the noise from the building work made conversation difficult.
primaryTranslation: 由于施工噪音让交谈变得困难，我们把会议转移到一间较小的房间。

english: that way that something happens or is done
primaryExample: She explained the problem in a calm manner, which helped everyone focus on finding a practical solution.
primaryTranslation: 她以平静的方式解释问题，这有助于大家集中精力寻找可行的解决办法。

english: a weapon that shoots small metal objects down a metal tube
primaryExample: The museum keeps the old gun behind protective glass and explains its history without allowing visitors to handle it.
primaryTranslation: 博物馆把那支旧枪放在防护玻璃后，并介绍其历史，不让游客触碰。

english: shape with four sides of equal length sides and four right (90°) angles
primaryExample: The children measured each side of the square carefully to check whether all four lengths were exactly equal.
primaryTranslation: 孩子们仔细测量正方形的每一条边，检查四条边的长度是否完全相等。

english: particular time when something important or special happens
primaryExample: They saved their best dishes for a special occasion, such as the evening when the whole family finally gathered together.
primaryTranslation: 他们把最好的餐具留到特别的日子使用，比如全家终于团聚的那个晚上。

english: well-known or easily recognized
primaryExample: The path looked familiar because we had followed the same route on a school trip several years earlier.
primaryTranslation: 这条小路看起来很熟悉，因为几年前学校组织旅行时，我们走过同样的路线。

english: to not listen to, look at, or pay attention to
primaryExample: We should not ignore the customer's concerns simply because the problem has not been reported by anyone else.
primaryTranslation: 我们不应仅仅因为别人还没有报告这个问题，就忽视这位顾客的担忧。

english: to damage something so badly that it no longer exists
primaryExample: A severe storm could destroy the temporary shelter, so the volunteers strengthened its roof before the bad weather arrived.
primaryTranslation: 强烈风暴可能毁掉临时住所，因此志愿者在恶劣天气来临前加固了屋顶。

english: event or a set of events, often unpleasant ones
primaryExample: The broken window became a complicated affair when the neighbours disagreed about who should pay for the repairs.
primaryTranslation: 邻居们对谁该支付维修费意见不一，让窗户破损这件事变得复杂起来。

english: related to the people of a country; not military/criminal
primaryExample: The exhibition explains how civil rights campaigns changed people's lives and encouraged wider participation in public decisions.
primaryTranslation: 这场展览解释了公民权利运动如何改变人们的生活，并鼓励更多人参与公共决策。

english: to find a certain place, position, or location of something
primaryExample: We used the map to locate the nearest railway station after discovering that our phone batteries were almost empty.
primaryTranslation: 发现手机快没电后，我们用地图寻找最近的火车站。

english: person who belongs to and has rights in a country
primaryExample: As a citizen, she believed it was important to understand local issues before deciding how to vote.
primaryTranslation: 作为一名公民，她认为在决定如何投票之前了解当地议题十分重要。

english: a measure of how hot or cold something is (e.g., the weather)
primaryExample: The temperature inside the greenhouse rose quickly, so we opened the windows to protect the young plants.
primaryTranslation: 温室里的温度迅速上升，于是我们打开窗户，保护幼小的植物。

english: soft yellow metal that is very valuable
primaryExample: The ring was made of gold, but its real value to her came from the family memories it carried.
primaryTranslation: 这枚戒指由黄金制成，但对她来说，它真正的价值在于承载的家庭回忆。

english: of or relating to a particular country; of or relating to the home and family
primaryExample: The airport's domestic flights leave from a smaller terminal, while international passengers use the main building next door.
primaryTranslation: 机场的国内航班从较小的航站楼出发，国际旅客则使用隔壁的主楼。

english: large, often heavy, amount of something to be moved
primaryExample: The driver checked that the heavy load was secure before beginning the long journey along the coast.
primaryTranslation: 司机在开始漫长的沿海行程前，检查了沉重的货物是否固定牢靠。

english: a feeling of being sure that something exists or is true
primaryExample: Her belief that everyone could improve with practice encouraged the less confident students to keep trying new tasks.
primaryTranslation: 她相信每个人都能通过练习进步，这鼓励了信心不足的学生继续尝试新任务。

english: group of soldiers; an organized group
primaryExample: A troop of soldiers helped carry supplies across the river after the storm damaged the village bridge.
primaryTranslation: 暴风雨损坏村里的桥后，一支部队帮助把物资运过河。

english: of practical use of machines or science in industry
primaryExample: We postponed the online meeting because a technical problem prevented several participants from hearing the discussion clearly.
primaryTranslation: 由于技术问题导致几位参与者无法清楚听到讨论，我们推迟了线上会议。

english: to make someone remember something
primaryExample: Please remind me to return the library books tomorrow, because I do not want to pay another late fee.
primaryTranslation: 请提醒我明天归还图书馆的书，因为我不想再付逾期费了。

english: plan or preparation to make something happen; an agreement
primaryExample: We made an arrangement with our neighbours to water each other's plants whenever one family was away on holiday.
primaryTranslation: 我们和邻居达成约定，一家外出度假时，另一家就帮忙浇花。

english: outer layer of an animal's or human's body
primaryExample: Her skin felt dry after the long flight, so she was glad to wash her face when she reached the hotel.
primaryTranslation: 长途飞行后她觉得皮肤干燥，所以到酒店后能洗把脸让她很高兴。

english: a place where people who have committed serious crimes are held
primaryExample: The visitor learned how education programmes in prison could help people prepare for life after their release.
primaryTranslation: 这位访客了解到，监狱里的教育项目可以帮助人们为获释后的生活作准备。

english: to change from one thing to another; (n) a thing you move to change from one thing to another
primaryExample: We decided to switch to a later train because the earlier service did not stop at our destination.
primaryTranslation: 我们决定改乘稍晚的火车，因为较早那班不在我们的目的地停靠。

english: to get or earn something by thinking or working
primaryExample: Students acquire useful research skills when they compare several sources instead of accepting the first answer they find.
primaryTranslation: 学生比较多个来源，而不直接接受找到的第一个答案时，就能获得有用的研究技能。

english: concerning (usually large) companies
primaryExample: The company revised its corporate policy after employees asked for clearer rules about working from home during the week.
primaryTranslation: 员工要求明确每周居家办公的规定后，公司修订了企业政策。

english: in a reasonable way; between a little and very much
primaryExample: The instructions were fairly clear, although we still needed help with the final stage of assembling the desk.
primaryTranslation: 说明相当清楚，不过我们在组装书桌的最后一步仍然需要帮助。

english: hard material that trees are made of and is used for building and fuel
primaryExample: We used wood from an old table to build shelves, which saved money and reduced the amount of waste.
primaryTranslation: 我们用一张旧桌子的木材制作架子，这既省了钱，也减少了废料。

english: to take part with others in doing something
primaryExample: Everyone was encouraged to participate in the discussion, including those who had not spoken at the previous meeting.
primaryTranslation: 大家都受到鼓励参与讨论，包括那些在上次会议中没有发言的人。

english: very difficult to do or deal with
primaryExample: It was a tough decision to leave the team, but she needed more time to care for her family.
primaryTranslation: 离开团队是一个艰难的决定，但她需要更多时间照顾家人。

english: 1. (v) to damage something by pulling it apart; 2. (n) drop of salty water from the eye
primaryExample: Be careful not to tear the old letter when you unfold it, because the paper has become very thin.
primaryTranslation: 展开这封旧信时小心别把它撕破，因为纸已经变得很薄了。

english: typical of a particular group or thing
primaryExample: The survey used a representative sample of residents so that its results would reflect the wider community's views.
primaryTranslation: 调查选用了有代表性的居民样本，以使结果反映更广泛社区的观点。

english: ability to hold, involve or contain people or things
primaryExample: The theatre reached its full capacity before the performance began, so late arrivals had to wait for another show.
primaryTranslation: 演出开始前剧院就已满座，因此晚到的人只能等另一场演出。

english: line separating one country or state from another
primaryExample: We crossed the border early in the morning, when there were fewer vehicles waiting at the checkpoint.
primaryTranslation: 我们清晨越过边境，当时在检查站等候的车辆较少。

english: to move something violently back and forth or up and down
primaryExample: Please shake the bottle gently before you pour the drink, as some of the fruit has settled at the bottom.
primaryTranslation: 倒饮料前请轻轻摇晃瓶子，因为有些果肉沉到了底部。

english: opinion based on judging the qualities of something or someone
primaryExample: The teacher's assessment included practical tasks, which allowed students to show skills that a written test might miss.
primaryTranslation: 老师的评价包括实践任务，让学生展示书面测试可能无法反映的技能。

english: outer covering worn on the foot to protect it usually sold in pairs
primaryExample: A small stone inside his shoe made walking uncomfortable until he stopped beside the path to remove it.
primaryTranslation: 他鞋里的一颗小石子让他走路很不舒服，直到他停在路旁把石子取出来。

english: what is expected; should
primaryExample: We ought to check the opening hours before travelling, since the museum sometimes closes earlier during the winter.
primaryTranslation: 我们应该在出发前查看开放时间，因为博物馆在冬季有时会提早关门。

english: public notice or advertisement
primaryExample: The job ad mentioned flexible hours, which interested people who needed to balance work with caring for children.
primaryTranslation: 招聘广告提到了灵活工时，这吸引了需要兼顾工作和照顾孩子的人。

english: amount of money paid for a particular service
primaryExample: There is a small entry fee, but the money helps the museum maintain its collection and run school visits.
primaryTranslation: 虽然需要支付少量入场费，但这笔钱帮助博物馆维护藏品，并组织学校参观。

english: a usually long, narrow room in a building  that leads to other rooms
primaryExample: We left our wet coats in the hall before entering the living room, where the rest of the family was waiting.
primaryTranslation: 我们先把湿外套留在门厅，再走进家里其他人正在等候的客厅。

english: official rule that controls how something is done
primaryExample: The new safety regulation requires every visitor to wear a helmet before entering the area where construction is taking place.
primaryTranslation: 新的安全规定要求每位访客在进入施工区域前都戴上头盔。

english: to get away from a place where you are being held
primaryExample: The family managed to escape through a back door before smoke made the main hallway impossible to use.
primaryTranslation: 在浓烟使主走廊无法通行之前，这一家人设法从后门逃了出去。

english: the building or room where art is made, such as paintings, movies, or music
primaryExample: The artist opened her studio to visitors so that they could see how a painting developed from the first sketch.
primaryTranslation: 这位画家向访客开放了工作室，让他们了解一幅画如何从最初的草图逐步完成。

english: correct according to social or moral rules
primaryExample: The teacher explained the proper way to handle the equipment before allowing us to begin the experiment ourselves.
primaryTranslation: 老师先解释了正确操作设备的方法，才允许我们自己开始实验。

english: to stop feeling nervous or worried; to rest and do something enjoyable
primaryExample: After several demanding weeks, they went to the coast to relax without checking messages or following a strict schedule.
primaryTranslation: 忙碌了好几周后，他们去海边放松，不再查看消息，也不再遵循严格的时间表。

english: someone who travels to a place for pleasure
primaryExample: The tourist asked a local shopkeeper for directions because the old streets were not clearly marked on her map.
primaryTranslation: 那位游客向当地店主问路，因为她的地图上没有清楚标出那些老街。

english: one of the parts that make up something
primaryExample: The engineer replaced one damaged component rather than throwing away the whole machine, which was still in good condition.
primaryTranslation: 工程师只更换了一个损坏的零件，而没有扔掉整台仍然状况良好的机器。

english: to have enough money to pay for something
primaryExample: We cannot afford to replace the car this year, so we are saving money for essential repairs instead.
primaryTranslation: 我们今年买不起新车来换掉旧车，所以正在存钱进行必要的维修。

english: a professional who is paid to help people with the law
primaryExample: The lawyer explained the agreement in plain language so that both sides understood their responsibilities before signing it.
primaryTranslation: 律师用通俗的语言解释了协议，让双方在签字前都理解自己的责任。

english: to think that someone may have committed a crime or done something wrong
primaryExample: The police suspect that someone entered through the kitchen window, although they have not yet found clear evidence.
primaryTranslation: 警方怀疑有人从厨房窗户进入，不过他们还没有找到明确的证据。

english: small round container used to hold liquids for drinking
primaryExample: She poured herself a cup of tea while waiting for the rain to stop before walking home.
primaryTranslation: 她给自己倒了一杯茶，等雨停后再步行回家。

english: something that tells you what something is like or looks like
primaryExample: The guide's detailed description helped us recognise the building immediately, even though we had never visited the town before.
primaryTranslation: 虽然我们从未到过这座城镇，但导游的详细描述帮助我们立刻认出了那栋建筑。

english: feeling that you can do well at something
primaryExample: Her confidence grew after she successfully explained her project to a group of people she had never met.
primaryTranslation: 她成功地向一群从未见过的人介绍自己的项目后，信心增强了。

english: concerning the people and businesses that make certain products
primaryExample: The former industrial area now contains workshops and cafes, although several old factory buildings have been carefully preserved.
primaryTranslation: 昔日的工业区如今有了工作坊和咖啡馆，不过几栋老厂房被仔细保留了下来。

english: to say that you are not happy or satisfied with something or someone
primaryExample: Customers began to complain when the website continued to accept orders for products that were no longer available.
primaryTranslation: 网站仍然接受已经缺货的商品订单时，顾客开始抱怨。

english: way of thinking, an attitude toward something
primaryExample: Working with people from different backgrounds gave her a broader perspective on problems she had once considered simple.
primaryTranslation: 与来自不同背景的人合作，让她对曾认为简单的问题有了更全面的看法。

english: something that is not correct; a mistake
primaryExample: We found an error in the timetable, which explained why several visitors had arrived an hour too early.
primaryTranslation: 我们发现时刻表里有一处错误，这解释了为什么几位访客提前一个小时到了。

english: to use the law to catch and keep people who committed crimes
primaryExample: Police decided not to arrest the man until they had checked whether the witness could identify him reliably.
primaryTranslation: 警方决定先核实证人能否可靠地认出那名男子，再决定是否逮捕他。

english: to judge something's value or suitability
primaryExample: Before we choose a new supplier, we need to assess whether it can deliver materials reliably throughout the year.
primaryTranslation: 选择新供应商之前，我们需要评估它能否全年稳定地供应材料。

english: to record your name on an official list; sign up
primaryExample: You must register for the workshop in advance because the room can only hold a limited number of participants.
primaryTranslation: 你必须提前报名参加工作坊，因为房间只能容纳有限数量的参与者。

english: a person or thing that has value or use to someone or to a company
primaryExample: Her ability to remain calm under pressure became a valuable asset when the team faced an unexpected problem.
primaryTranslation: 当团队遇到意外问题时，她在压力下保持冷静的能力成了宝贵的优势。

english: An action, change, or process that gives information about something
primaryExample: The guide raised her hand as a signal that the group should stop talking and listen to the announcement.
primaryTranslation: 导游举起手，示意大家停止交谈，听广播通知。

english: one of the five long parts of the hand
primaryExample: She ran a finger along the map to show the route we would follow after leaving the village.
primaryTranslation: 她用一根手指沿着地图移动，指示我们离开村庄后要走的路线。

english: direct related to a subject in a considerable way
primaryExample: Please include only relevant information in your application so that the reader can quickly understand why you suit the role.
primaryTranslation: 请在申请中只填写相关信息，让阅读者迅速理解你为什么适合这个岗位。

english: to learn about something by examining in detail or someplace by traveling to it
primaryExample: During the afternoon, we had enough time to explore the old harbour and learn why it had once been important.
primaryTranslation: 下午我们有足够的时间探索老港口，了解它为什么曾经十分重要。

english: quality of being able to guide or influence others
primaryExample: Under her leadership, the team began sharing ideas more openly instead of waiting for someone else to make every decision.
primaryTranslation: 在她的领导下，团队开始更坦诚地分享想法，而不是等着别人作出每一个决定。

english: a promise or decision to do something; something that you must do that takes your time
primaryExample: Joining the evening course requires a commitment to regular study, especially when you already have a busy working week.
primaryTranslation: 参加晚间课程需要承诺坚持学习，尤其是在你一周工作本来就很忙的情况下。

english: to stop sleeping; to make someone stop sleeping
primaryExample: I usually wake before the alarm rings, but after the long journey I slept until almost ten.
primaryTranslation: 我通常在闹钟响之前就醒来，但长途旅行后，我一直睡到将近十点。

english: in a way that is needed or required, or is unavoidable
primaryExample: A more expensive product is not necessarily better, particularly if it includes features that you will never use.
primaryTranslation: 更贵的产品不一定更好，尤其是它包含一些你永远用不到的功能时。

english: producing a lot of light
primaryExample: The kitchen was bright even on cloudy days because its large windows faced the open garden behind the house.
primaryTranslation: 即使阴天，厨房里也很明亮，因为大窗户正对着房子后面的开阔花园。

chinese: （名词）1.框架；2.帧，画面（动词）1.做边框；2.做伪证
english: (n) 1. the basic structure of something that gives it its shape, to which other parts are added; 2. one picture in a series that make a video; (v) 1. to put a picture in a supporting structure; 2. to produce false evidence so an innocent person appears guilty of a crime
primaryExample: The wooden frame was still strong, so we repaired the seat instead of buying a completely new chair.
primaryTranslation: 木框架仍很结实，所以我们修好了椅面，而没有买一把全新的椅子。

english: done in a way that takes a long time
primaryExample: We walked slowly through the gallery so that we had time to notice details in the paintings and discuss them.
primaryTranslation: 我们慢慢走过画廊，这样就有时间注意画中的细节，并进行讨论。

english: something that joins or connects people, groups, or parts; a duty or promise to another; glue
primaryExample: The bond between the neighbours grew stronger after they worked together to repair the damage caused by the storm.
primaryTranslation: 邻居们一起修复风暴造成的损坏后，彼此之间的联系更加紧密了。

english: to employ a person to do a particular job
primaryExample: The company plans to hire two experienced designers who can help improve products without making them more expensive.
primaryTranslation: 公司计划聘用两位经验丰富的设计师，帮助改进产品，同时不提高售价。

english: hollow place; opening into or through something
primaryExample: We noticed a small hole in the tent just before the rain started, so we covered it immediately.
primaryTranslation: 下雨前，我们发现帐篷上有一个小洞，于是立刻把它盖住了。

english: to join together two ends of string or rope; to join two or more things together with string or rope
primaryExample: You should tie the bags securely before putting them in the car, otherwise their contents may fall out.
primaryTranslation: 把袋子放进车里之前应该扎紧，否则里面的东西可能会掉出来。

english: within or inside
primaryExample: An internal review showed that several departments were collecting the same information without sharing it with one another.
primaryTranslation: 一次内部审查发现，几个部门都在收集同样的信息，却没有互相分享。

english: series of connected  things, events, or people
primaryExample: The delayed delivery started a chain of problems that affected every workshop waiting for the same materials.
primaryTranslation: 交货延误引发了一连串问题，影响了所有等待同样材料的车间。

english: writings that are valued as works of art, esp. fiction, drama and poetry
primaryExample: Reading literature from different countries helped her understand how people described family life in different periods of history.
primaryTranslation: 阅读不同国家的文学作品，帮助她了解人们如何描述不同历史时期的家庭生活。

english: person who has suffered from a crime, bad situation, or event
primaryExample: The charity offered temporary accommodation to every victim of the flood who could not safely return home.
primaryTranslation: 慈善机构为每一位无法安全返家的洪灾受害者提供了临时住所。

english: to say you will harm or hurt someone
primaryExample: The landlord must not threaten tenants who ask for essential repairs, even if he disagrees with their complaints.
primaryTranslation: 即使房东不同意租客的投诉，也不能威胁那些要求进行必要维修的租客。

english: act of separating something into parts; groups formed by different functions or opinions
primaryExample: The division of tasks was clear, so each volunteer knew what to do when the first visitors arrived.
primaryTranslation: 任务分工很明确，因此第一批访客到达时，每位志愿者都知道该做什么。

english: to protect something from danger or harm, keep things safe
primaryExample: We used a strong cover to secure the equipment against rain while it was being transported to the island.
primaryTranslation: 设备被运往岛上的过程中，我们用结实的罩子保护它免受雨淋。

english: to cause wonder; to surprise completely
primaryExample: It continues to amaze me how much useful information we can find by asking careful questions and listening patiently.
primaryTranslation: 通过认真提问和耐心倾听能够获取如此多的有用信息，这一点始终让我惊讶。

english: object, machine, or equipment for a specific use
primaryExample: The small device measures how much electricity each appliance uses, helping families identify where they can reduce waste.
primaryTranslation: 这个小装置测量每件电器的用电量，帮助家庭发现哪里可以减少浪费。

english: when a baby comes out of the body of its mother
primaryExample: After the birth of their daughter, they moved closer to family so that relatives could visit more easily.
primaryTranslation: 女儿出生后，他们搬到了离家人更近的地方，以便亲戚更方便地来访。

english: large area with many trees
primaryExample: We followed a marked path through the forest because leaving it could disturb wildlife and make finding our way difficult.
primaryTranslation: 我们沿着标记好的小路穿过森林，因为离开小路可能打扰野生动物，也容易迷路。

english: a piece of paper or cloth that is attached to something and gives information about it
primaryExample: Before washing the jacket, check the label inside to find out which temperature and washing method are recommended.
primaryTranslation: 洗这件夹克之前，先查看里面的标签，了解建议的水温和洗涤方法。

english: part of a plant that grows underground
primaryExample: The tree's damaged root could no longer support it properly, so experts advised removing it before the next storm.
primaryTranslation: 树木受损的根已无法稳固地支撑它，因此专家建议在下一场风暴前移除这棵树。

english: building where things are made
primaryExample: The factory introduced quieter machines after nearby residents complained that production continued long after they had gone to bed.
primaryTranslation: 附近居民抱怨他们上床很久后工厂仍在生产，于是工厂引进了更安静的机器。

english: the amount of money that is needed to pay for something
primaryExample: We shared the expense of hiring a car because travelling together was cheaper than buying separate train tickets.
primaryTranslation: 我们分担了租车费用，因为一起出行比各自购买火车票更便宜。

english: 1. a narrow, deep body of water used by ships; 2. a system used for sending something from one place or person to another
primaryExample: The narrow channel between the two islands became difficult to cross when strong winds pushed waves against the boats.
primaryTranslation: 大风把海浪推向船只，使两座岛之间狭窄的水道变得难以穿越。

english: to try to find out facts; to carry out research
primaryExample: The school will investigate why the heating failed so that the same problem does not interrupt lessons next winter.
primaryTranslation: 学校将调查暖气故障的原因，避免明年冬天再因同样的问题影响上课。

english: suggestion about someone or something being a good choice
primaryExample: We booked the restaurant on a friend's recommendation, and its quiet atmosphere made it perfect for our family celebration.
primaryTranslation: 我们听从朋友的推荐预订了这家餐厅，其安静的氛围十分适合我们的家庭庆祝活动。

english: to place someone or something in higher or lower position relative to others
primaryExample: The judges rank each design according to its usefulness, appearance, and the amount of material needed to produce it.
primaryTranslation: 评委根据实用性、外观和生产所需的材料数量，对每个设计进行排名。

english: normal; usual; expected
primaryExample: A typical day on the farm begins before sunrise, when the animals need feeding and the fields are still quiet.
primaryTranslation: 农场里普通的一天从日出前开始，那时需要喂动物，田野也还很安静。

english: the direction where the sun sets; opposite of east
primaryExample: The village lies to the west of the lake, where a narrow road connects it with the nearest town.
primaryTranslation: 村庄位于湖的西边，一条狭窄的公路把它与最近的城镇连接起来。

english: acting like a friend; kind and helpful
primaryExample: The staff were friendly and patient, even when visitors asked the same questions repeatedly during the busiest part of the day.
primaryTranslation: 即使游客在一天最忙的时候反复提出同样的问题，工作人员仍然友好而耐心。

english: a person, animal, or plant who lives in a particular place
primaryExample: Each resident received a letter explaining when the water would be turned off and how long the repairs would take.
primaryTranslation: 每位居民都收到了一封信，说明何时停水以及维修需要多长时间。

english: 1. supplies that are needed or wanted; something that is supplied; 2. part of a law or an agreement
primaryExample: The agreement includes a provision that allows either side to request a review if the working conditions change significantly.
primaryTranslation: 协议包含一项条款，允许任何一方在工作条件发生重大变化时要求重新审查。

english: to give all your attention to a task; focus
primaryExample: I find it easier to concentrate on difficult tasks when I put my phone away and close unnecessary computer windows.
primaryTranslation: 把手机放到一旁并关闭不必要的电脑窗口后，我更容易专注于困难的任务。

english: a large  amount of something; a lot; not too little
primaryExample: There was plenty of time before the train left, so we decided to have breakfast at a nearby cafe.
primaryTranslation: 离火车出发还有充足的时间，所以我们决定去附近的咖啡馆吃早餐。

english: to send goods to be sold in another country
primaryExample: Local farmers export their fruit to neighbouring countries, where it can be sold soon after it has been picked.
primaryTranslation: 当地农民把水果出口到邻国，让水果在采摘后不久就能出售。

english: fully or completely
primaryExample: The delay was not entirely the driver's fault, because road repairs had made the usual route impossible to follow.
primaryTranslation: 延误并不完全是司机的错，因为道路维修使通常的路线无法通行。

english: in a strong manner; in a very serious way
primaryExample: She strongly recommended visiting the museum early, before large groups arrived and made the smaller galleries feel crowded.
primaryTranslation: 她强烈建议早点去博物馆，以免大批参观团到来后，小展厅变得拥挤。

english: structure built over river or road so people, vehicles, or animals can cross
primaryExample: The old bridge was closed to heavy vehicles after engineers discovered damage that required several months of careful repair.
primaryTranslation: 工程师发现旧桥的损坏需要数月细致维修后，禁止重型车辆通行。

english: to have as an essential, necessary or main part
primaryExample: The course will consist of weekly discussions and practical projects, rather than relying entirely on lectures and written tests.
primaryTranslation: 这门课程将由每周讨论和实践项目组成，而不是完全依赖讲课和笔试。

english: (v) to receive a degree from a college or university; (n) a person who has received a degree
primaryExample: She hopes to graduate next summer and then spend a year gaining experience before applying for further study.
primaryTranslation: 她希望明年夏天毕业，然后先积累一年的经验，再申请继续深造。

english: name given to a product or service
primaryExample: We chose a familiar brand because we wanted replacement parts that would remain easy to find in a few years.
primaryTranslation: 我们选择了一个熟悉的品牌，因为希望几年后仍能方便地找到替换零件。

english: relating to people's belief about right or wrong behavior
primaryExample: The story raises a difficult moral question about whether helping one person can justify treating someone else unfairly.
primaryTranslation: 这个故事提出了一个棘手的道德问题：帮助一个人能否成为不公平对待另一个人的理由。

english: to state your opinion strongly and firmly; to demand that something must happen
primaryExample: The guide continued to insist that everyone stay together, because the narrow mountain paths were easy to confuse.
primaryTranslation: 导游始终坚持让大家待在一起，因为那些狭窄的山路很容易混淆。

english: result of mixing things together
primaryExample: A combination of clear instructions and patient support helped the new volunteers feel confident during their first busy afternoon.
primaryTranslation: 清楚的说明与耐心的支持相结合，让新志愿者在第一个忙碌的下午建立了信心。

english: to treat someone or something in a way that is cruel, harmful, or wrong
primaryExample: Managers must never abuse their staff, even when pressure at work makes it difficult to remain calm and patient.
primaryTranslation: 即使工作压力让人难以保持冷静耐心，管理者也绝不能虐待员工。

english: frozen water
primaryExample: A thin layer of ice covered the path, so we walked carefully and held the rail beside the steps.
primaryTranslation: 一层薄冰覆盖着小路，所以我们小心行走，并扶着台阶旁的栏杆。

english: 1. most important; main; 2.  the person in charge of a (US) public school
primaryExample: The principal reason for choosing this location was its easy access to public transport, rather than its lower rent.
primaryTranslation: 选择这个地点的主要原因是公共交通方便，而不是租金较低。

english: 1. someone who has control over others; 2. someone who is very skilled at doing something
primaryExample: The young musician watched a master at work, hoping to understand how years of practice could produce such effortless control.
primaryTranslation: 这位年轻音乐家观察一位大师的演奏，希望理解多年练习如何带来如此从容的控制力。

english: without question; beyond doubt
primaryExample: We will definitely return to the village next year if we can arrange enough time away from work.
primaryTranslation: 如果能安排出足够的休假时间，我们明年肯定会再去那个村庄。

english: period of time for doing a particular activity
primaryExample: During the final training session, participants worked together to solve a problem that combined everything they had learned.
primaryTranslation: 在最后一次培训中，参与者一起解决了一个综合运用所学内容的问题。

english: level of study that is completed by a student
primaryExample: Children in the same grade may develop different strengths, so the teacher offers several ways to complete each task.
primaryTranslation: 同年级的孩子可能有不同的长处，因此老师为完成每项任务提供了多种方式。

english: in spite of what has just been said; nonetheless
primaryExample: The journey took longer than expected; nevertheless, we arrived in time to see the beginning of the performance.
primaryTranslation: 旅途花的时间比预期长；不过，我们还是及时赶上了演出的开场。

english: to guess or estimate what will or might happen
primaryExample: It is difficult to predict how many people will attend, so we have reserved a room with extra space.
primaryTranslation: 很难预测有多少人参加，因此我们预订了一间空间较充足的房间。

english: at an earlier time
primaryExample: The building had previously been a school, which explained the large windows and unusually wide corridors on every floor.
primaryTranslation: 这栋楼以前是一所学校，这解释了它为什么有大窗户，而且每层的走廊都格外宽。

english: being kept from harm
primaryExample: The fence offers some protection from the wind, but the young trees still need support during severe storms.
primaryTranslation: 围栏能够起到一定的防风作用，但幼树在强烈风暴中仍需要支撑。

english: in large part; mainly or chiefly
primaryExample: The event succeeded largely because local volunteers offered their time, allowing the organisers to keep ticket prices affordable.
primaryTranslation: 活动成功主要归功于当地志愿者付出时间，使组织者能够把票价维持在可负担的水平。

english: to marry; to get married
primaryExample: They plan to wed in a small village ceremony, where their closest friends and relatives can celebrate together.
primaryTranslation: 他们计划在村里举办小型婚礼，让最亲密的朋友和亲人一起庆祝。

english: to pay money for the use of something
primaryExample: We decided to rent a flat near the station so that neither of us would need a car for work.
primaryTranslation: 我们决定在车站附近租一套公寓，这样我们俩上班都不需要开车。

english: the act of firing a gun, or kicking or throwing a ball at a goal
primaryExample: The goalkeeper saved the final shot, which allowed her team to keep its lead until the match ended.
primaryTranslation: 守门员扑出了最后一次射门，使她的球队得以保持领先直到比赛结束。

english: way that someone or something looks
primaryExample: The building's appearance changed completely after its dark walls were cleaned and the damaged windows were carefully replaced.
primaryTranslation: 深色墙面被清洗、受损窗户被仔细更换之后，这栋楼的外观彻底改变了。

english: fair and sensible; appropriate
primaryExample: It seems reasonable to allow extra travel time when you know that road repairs may cause delays along the route.
primaryTranslation: 既然知道沿途的道路维修可能导致延误，预留额外的出行时间似乎很合理。

english: to make a formal promise that something will happen or be done.
primaryExample: The shop cannot guarantee that repairs will be finished today, but it will contact us as soon as the bicycle is ready.
primaryTranslation: 商店无法保证今天修完，但自行车修好后会尽快联系我们。

english: until
primaryExample: We waited till the last visitors had left before closing the doors and checking that all the lights were off.
primaryTranslation: 我们等到最后一批访客离开后，才关门并检查所有灯是否都已关闭。

english: main subject to discuss or describe
primaryExample: The main theme of the exhibition is how ordinary families adapted when new industries changed the towns around them.
primaryTranslation: 展览的主要主题是：新兴工业改变周围城镇时，普通家庭如何适应。

english: opinion that is made after careful consideration
primaryExample: His judgment was based on several years of experience, although he still listened carefully to people who disagreed.
primaryTranslation: 他的判断建立在多年经验之上，不过他仍认真倾听不同意见。

english: strange or different from what is usual or expected
primaryExample: It seemed odd that the cafe was empty, until we noticed a sign explaining that it had not opened yet.
primaryTranslation: 咖啡馆里空无一人显得很奇怪，直到我们注意到标牌说明它还没开门。

english: to have a positive opinion of someone or something
primaryExample: My parents approve of my decision to study abroad, although they are worried about how far away I will be.
primaryTranslation: 父母赞成我出国留学的决定，不过他们担心我会离家太远。

english: something (usually money) that is given to someone for a period of time with a promise that it will be returned
primaryExample: They took out a small loan to buy essential equipment, then repaid it gradually as their business began to grow.
primaryTranslation: 他们申请了一笔小额贷款购买必要设备，随后随着生意发展逐步还款。

english: explanation of word's meaning, as in dictionaries
primaryExample: The dictionary gives a clear definition, but the examples show more effectively how the word is used in everyday conversation.
primaryTranslation: 词典给出了清楚的定义，但例句更有效地展示了这个词在日常交谈中的用法。

english: choose someone for a position usually by voting
primaryExample: The members will elect a new chairperson next month after each candidate has explained their plans for the organisation.
primaryTranslation: 下个月，每位候选人介绍完组织发展计划后，成员们将选出新主席。

english: The mixture of gases surrounding the Earth; the feeling that a place or situation gives you
primaryExample: The restaurant had a relaxed atmosphere, which made it easy for colleagues to talk after a demanding day at work.
primaryTranslation: 这家餐厅的氛围很轻松，让同事们在辛苦工作一天后能够自在交谈。

english: someone who owns or looks after farm, a place for growing crops and keeping animals
primaryExample: The farmer explained why different crops needed different amounts of water, especially during the unusually dry summer months.
primaryTranslation: 农民解释了不同作物为什么需要不同的水量，尤其是在异常干旱的夏季。

english: looking for differences and similarities in two or more things
primaryExample: A careful comparison of the two courses helped me choose the one that offered more opportunities for practical work.
primaryTranslation: 仔细比较两门课程后，我选择了那门提供更多实践机会的课程。

english: a typical feature or quality that a particular person or thing has
primaryExample: The artist's characteristic use of strong colours makes her paintings easy to recognise, even when they show very different subjects.
primaryTranslation: 这位画家惯用鲜明色彩，即使画作表现的主题差异很大，也很容易辨认。

english: official document which allows a person to do or have something
primaryExample: You need a valid driving license to hire a car, and some companies also require a minimum age.
primaryTranslation: 租车需要有效驾照，而且一些公司还规定了最低年龄。

english: able to depend on
primaryExample: We cannot rely on one person to organise everything, so each member of the team has agreed to help.
primaryTranslation: 我们不能依靠一个人安排所有事情，因此团队每位成员都同意帮忙。

english: long but not wide; a small distance from one side to the other compared to length
primaryExample: The narrow doorway made it difficult to move the sofa inside, so we removed its legs before trying again.
primaryTranslation: 狭窄的门口使沙发很难搬进屋，因此我们先卸下沙发腿，再次尝试。

english: to finally achieve something that you were trying to achieve
primaryExample: You are more likely to succeed if you divide a difficult task into smaller steps and review your progress regularly.
primaryTranslation: 如果把困难的任务分成小步骤，并定期回顾进展，就更有可能成功。

english: who someone is; the collection of qualities that makes a person
primaryExample: The receptionist checked my identity before giving me a visitor's pass and directions to the room where the meeting was taking place.
primaryTranslation: 接待员核实我的身份后，给了我访客证，并告诉我会议室怎么走。

english: a piece of furniture like a table often with drawers
primaryExample: She moved her desk beside the window so that she could work in natural light during the shorter winter days.
primaryTranslation: 她把书桌搬到窗边，以便在白昼较短的冬季利用自然光工作。

english: to allow someone to do something or for something to happen
primaryExample: The museum does not permit visitors to touch the objects, because even clean hands can damage their delicate surfaces.
primaryTranslation: 博物馆不允许访客触摸展品，因为即使干净的手也可能损伤其脆弱的表面。

english: in a serious way; in a way that shows something is important
primaryExample: She took the feedback seriously and revised her report instead of assuming that the reader had simply misunderstood her.
primaryTranslation: 她认真对待反馈并修改了报告，而不是认为读者只是误解了她。

english: living in nature; not tame
primaryExample: Visitors should watch wild animals from a distance rather than approaching them for a photograph or offering them food.
primaryTranslation: 游客应该远距离观察野生动物，而不是为拍照而靠近，或给它们喂食。

english: containing nothing; with no contents
primaryExample: The hall was almost empty by the time we arrived, because most guests had already left to catch the last train.
primaryTranslation: 我们到达时大厅几乎空了，因为大多数客人已经离开去赶末班火车。

english: a group officially put in charge of finding out about something or controlling something
primaryExample: The government appointed a commission to examine the problem and recommend changes after hearing evidence from several communities.
primaryTranslation: 政府任命了一个委员会，在听取多个社区的证据后，研究问题并提出改革建议。

english: unlike other things; being the only one like it
primaryExample: Each village has a unique history, which local guides share through stories about the buildings and families that remain.
primaryTranslation: 每个村庄都有独特的历史，当地导游通过讲述现存建筑和家族的故事来介绍它。

english: organization of people with the same interest
primaryExample: The local sports association organised a weekend event so that children could try activities they had never experienced before.
primaryTranslation: 当地体育协会组织了周末活动，让孩子们体验从未尝试过的项目。

english: a piece of equipment used for a particular purpose such as making music or measuring something
primaryExample: Learning a musical instrument requires patience, because small improvements often become noticeable only after many weeks of regular practice.
primaryTranslation: 学习乐器需要耐心，因为细微的进步往往要经过数周的规律练习才会显现。

english: a person who gives money to help a business grow for a profit
primaryExample: The investor asked to see a clear business plan before deciding whether the small company was likely to grow.
primaryTranslation: 投资者要求先看一份清晰的商业计划，再判断这家小公司是否可能发展壮大。

english: relating to what is sensible, real, or useful rather than with ideas or theories
primaryExample: The workshop offered practical advice on repairing household items, so participants could apply what they learned as soon as they returned home.
primaryTranslation: 工作坊提供了维修家居用品的实用建议，让参与者回家后就能运用所学。

english: drink made when you put dried leaves in hot water
primaryExample: We stopped for tea at a small cafe, where the owner told us which walking paths were still open.
primaryTranslation: 我们在一家小咖啡馆停下来喝茶，店主告诉了我们哪些步道仍然开放。

english: attractive or beautiful
primaryExample: The village was particularly lovely in spring, when flowers covered the walls and the surrounding hills were bright green.
primaryTranslation: 春天的村庄格外美丽，花朵爬满墙壁，周围的山丘一片翠绿。

english: easy to press, bend or cut; not hard or firm
primaryExample: The soft fabric felt comfortable against her skin, although she wondered whether it would be strong enough for everyday use.
primaryTranslation: 这种柔软面料贴着皮肤很舒服，不过她怀疑它能否经得起日常使用。

english: a straight line of people or things; one after another
primaryExample: We sat in the front row so that the children could see the demonstration without having to look over anyone's shoulders.
primaryTranslation: 我们坐在前排，让孩子们不用越过别人的肩膀也能看清演示。

english: when you are young; a young person
primaryExample: During his youth, he spent most summers helping on his grandparents' farm, where he developed an interest in wildlife.
primaryTranslation: 年轻时，他大多数夏天都在祖父母的农场帮忙，并在那里对野生动物产生了兴趣。

english: to close something with a device so others can't open it
primaryExample: Remember to lock the side gate when you leave, because it sometimes swings open when the wind becomes stronger.
primaryTranslation: 离开时记得锁上侧门，因为风变大时，它有时会被吹开。

english: material used to produce heat or power when burned
primaryExample: The driver checked how much fuel remained before deciding whether it was safe to continue to the next town.
primaryTranslation: 司机先检查剩余燃料，才决定能否安全地继续开往下一座城镇。

english: a belief or hope that something is going to happen
primaryExample: Her expectation of the course changed after she discovered that most lessons involved discussion rather than listening to long lectures.
primaryTranslation: 发现大多数课都以讨论而不是长时间听讲为主后，她对这门课程的预期发生了变化。

english: having a job; work done for money
primaryExample: The centre offers training and advice to people seeking employment, including those returning to work after several years away.
primaryTranslation: 中心为求职者提供培训和建议，包括那些离职数年后重新就业的人。

chinese: 庆祝（事件或节日），过（生日）
english: to observe an event or occasion (e.g., a birthday)
primaryExample: We decided to celebrate the end of the project with a shared meal, giving everyone a chance to relax together.
primaryTranslation: 我们决定一起聚餐庆祝项目结束，让每个人都有机会共同放松一下。

english: concerning physical activity that can produce babies
primaryExample: The school invited a qualified educator to discuss sexual health in an age-appropriate lesson that allowed students to ask questions privately.
primaryTranslation: 学校邀请了一位合格的教育人员，在符合年龄的课程中讲解性健康，并允许学生私下提问。

english: the part of the body where an arm attaches or joins
primaryExample: She carried the bag over one shoulder until it became uncomfortable, then stopped to move some books into her backpack.
primaryTranslation: 她把包挎在一边肩上，直到感到不舒服，才停下来把一些书移进双肩包。

english: air you take in and out of your body
primaryExample: He paused to catch his breath after climbing the stairs, then continued explaining why he had arrived late.
primaryTranslation: 爬完楼梯后，他停下来喘口气，然后继续解释自己迟到的原因。

english: more and more; in greater degree or amount
primaryExample: The town has become increasingly popular with visitors since the railway reopened and made weekend trips much easier to organise.
primaryTranslation: 铁路重新开放、周末旅行变得更容易安排后，这座城镇越来越受游客欢迎。

english: to bring items or goods from one country into another
primaryExample: The shop used to import all its furniture, but it now works with local makers to reduce transport costs.
primaryTranslation: 这家商店以前进口所有家具，如今则与当地制造商合作，以降低运输成本。

english: a container with a narrow neck used to hold liquids like water or wine
primaryExample: He filled a reusable bottle before leaving, since there would be nowhere to buy drinking water along the route.
primaryTranslation: 他出发前装满了一个可重复使用的水瓶，因为沿途没有地方购买饮用水。

english: used by a speaker to show that they and one or more people are affected by their action
primaryExample: We decided to repair the shelf ourselves, although we asked a more experienced neighbour to check that it was secure.
primaryTranslation: 我们决定自己修架子，不过请了一位更有经验的邻居检查它是否牢固。

english: a large piece of fabric or material that is used to cover something, often a bed
primaryExample: She folded the clean sheet carefully before putting it in the cupboard where the spare blankets were kept.
primaryTranslation: 她仔细叠好干净的床单，然后放进存放备用毯子的柜子里。

english: a machine that changes energy into motion
primaryExample: The engine began making an unusual sound, so the driver pulled over rather than risk continuing along the busy road.
primaryTranslation: 发动机开始发出异常声音，因此司机靠边停车，没有冒险继续在繁忙道路上行驶。

english: to send, throw, or move something or someone in a direction
primaryExample: The fisherman cast his line towards the deeper water, hoping the fish would be more active away from the shore.
primaryTranslation: 渔夫朝较深的水域抛出钓线，希望远离岸边的鱼儿更活跃。

english: idea or opinion about doing something
primaryExample: She rejected the notion that only naturally talented people could learn to draw, and encouraged everyone to practise regularly.
primaryTranslation: 她不认同只有天生有才能的人才能学会画画的看法，并鼓励大家定期练习。

english: preferring traditional styles and values
primaryExample: His taste in clothes is rather conservative, so he chose a plain dark suit instead of the brighter designs.
primaryTranslation: 他的着装品味比较保守，因此他选了一套素色深色西装，而不是那些鲜艳的款式。

english: traveling from one place to another; trip
primaryExample: The journey took longer than expected because we stopped several times to enjoy the views along the coast.
primaryTranslation: 这趟行程比预期更长，因为我们多次停下来欣赏沿海的景色。

english: act of disagreeing or trying to stop something
primaryExample: The proposal faced strong opposition from residents who believed the new road would bring too much traffic into the village.
primaryTranslation: 居民强烈反对这项提案，因为他们认为新路会让太多车辆进入村庄。

english: the pleasant and relaxed feeling when something unpleasant stops or does not happen
primaryExample: There was a clear sense of relief when the missing dog returned, just as the family was preparing to search again.
primaryTranslation: 失踪的狗回来了，当时家人正准备再次寻找，大家明显松了一口气。

english: the sum of money owed to somebody that is not yet paid
primaryExample: They worked out a careful budget so that they could reduce their debt without giving up every enjoyable activity.
primaryTranslation: 他们制定了细致的预算，以便在不放弃所有娱乐活动的情况下减少债务。

english: respect given to someone who is admired
primaryExample: It was an honor to introduce the teacher who had helped so many students discover a love of reading.
primaryTranslation: 能介绍这位帮助许多学生爱上阅读的老师，是一种荣幸。

english: something that happens as a result, consequence
primaryExample: The outcome of the discussion surprised us, because both sides agreed to changes that had seemed impossible the previous week.
primaryTranslation: 讨论的结果让我们很惊讶，因为双方同意了上周还看似不可能的调整。

english: to say someone is responsible for something bad
primaryExample: It is unfair to blame one person for a delay when several departments failed to share the necessary information.
primaryTranslation: 多个部门都没有分享必要信息时，把延误归咎于一个人是不公平的。

english: details or reasons given to make something clear
primaryExample: Her explanation was clear enough for everyone to understand why the schedule had changed and what would happen next.
primaryTranslation: 她的解释足够清楚，让大家都明白时间安排为何改变，以及接下来会发生什么。

english: to begin, to start to happen
primaryExample: If any problems arise during your stay, please contact reception rather than trying to repair the equipment yourself.
primaryTranslation: 如果入住期间出现问题，请联系前台，而不要尝试自己维修设备。

english: play or movie set to music
primaryExample: We watched a musical about a small town whose residents worked together to save their old theatre from closing.
primaryTranslation: 我们看了一部音乐剧，讲的是一个小镇的居民齐心协力，阻止老剧院关闭的故事。

english: to become healthy after an illness or injury; to get better
primaryExample: She needed several weeks to recover after the operation, so her colleagues shared her tasks until she returned.
primaryTranslation: 她手术后需要几周时间恢复，因此同事们分担了她的任务，直到她回来。

english: father
primaryExample: My dad taught me to check the weather before hiking, especially when a clear morning could turn into a stormy afternoon.
primaryTranslation: 爸爸教我徒步前先看天气，尤其是在晴朗早晨可能变成暴风雨下午的情况下。

english: to make something bigger or looser by pulling on it
primaryExample: Try not to stretch the fabric too far when you pull it over the frame, or it may lose its shape.
primaryTranslation: 把布料拉到框架上时，尽量别拉得太过，否则它可能变形。

english: to say something in an official or sure way
primaryExample: The organisers will declare the results once all the judges have checked their scores and signed the final report.
primaryTranslation: 所有评委核对分数并签署最终报告后，组织者将宣布结果。

english: to stop working because you have reached a certain age
primaryExample: He plans to retire next year, although he hopes to continue helping at the community centre a few days each month.
primaryTranslation: 他计划明年退休，不过希望每月仍能去社区中心帮忙几天。

english: very, very small
primaryExample: A tiny crack in the window let cold air into the room, even when the curtains were fully closed.
primaryTranslation: 窗户上的一道细小裂缝使冷空气进入房间，即使窗帘完全拉上也是如此。

english: thinking about what you are doing in order to avoid a mistake
primaryExample: Be careful when carrying the old dishes, because several of them already have cracks that are difficult to notice.
primaryTranslation: 搬运这些旧餐具时要小心，因为其中几件已经有了不容易察觉的裂纹。

english: acceptable or right for someone or something
primaryExample: We need a venue that is suitable for families, with enough space for children to move around safely.
primaryTranslation: 我们需要一个适合家庭的场地，提供足够空间，让孩子们能够安全地活动。

english: being from or living in the place where you were born
primaryExample: As a native of the island, she knew which paths remained safe when heavy rain made the main road difficult.
primaryTranslation: 作为岛上的本地人，她知道大雨使主路难行时，哪些小路仍然安全。

english: food that grows on a tree or bush
primaryExample: We bought fresh fruit at the market because it was cheaper than the packaged snacks sold near the station.
primaryTranslation: 我们在市场买了新鲜水果，因为它比车站附近卖的包装零食便宜。

english: to study carefully to find out the meaning of
primaryExample: The students will analyze the survey results before deciding whether their original prediction was supported by the evidence.
primaryTranslation: 学生们将分析调查结果，再判断证据是否支持他们最初的预测。

english: a person who sees something happen
primaryExample: The witness described what she had seen from her window, but she admitted that the street had been poorly lit.
primaryTranslation: 目击者描述了她从窗户看到的情况，但承认街上光线很暗。

english: a letter, package, or email
primaryExample: We asked our neighbour to collect the mail while we were away, so that important letters would not be left outside.
primaryTranslation: 我们请邻居在我们外出时收取邮件，以免重要信件被留在外面。

english: very bad; horrible
primaryExample: The weather was terrible throughout the weekend, but we enjoyed exploring the museum instead of walking along the beach.
primaryTranslation: 整个周末天气都很糟糕，不过我们没有沿海滩散步，而是愉快地参观了博物馆。

english: a person who studies something carefully to learn new information
primaryExample: The researcher interviewed local residents to understand how the new railway had affected their work and daily travel.
primaryTranslation: 研究员采访了当地居民，以了解新铁路如何影响他们的工作和日常出行。

english: not special, different, or unusual
primaryExample: What began as an ordinary walk became memorable when we discovered an old garden hidden behind the village church.
primaryTranslation: 一次平常的散步变得令人难忘，因为我们发现了藏在村庄教堂后面的古老花园。

english: the act of carefully choosing something or someone from a group
primaryExample: The selection of volunteers took longer than expected because the organisers wanted people with a wide range of useful skills.
primaryTranslation: 志愿者选拔比预计花的时间更长，因为组织者希望找到拥有多种实用技能的人。

chinese: 在任何地方（用于疑问句，否定句）
english: in, at, or to any place; used in questions, with 'not'
primaryExample: We could not find a quiet table anywhere in the station, so we waited outside until the next train arrived.
primaryTranslation: 车站里哪里都找不到安静的桌子，所以我们在外面等到下一班火车到来。

english: concerning the mind
primaryExample: Regular breaks can reduce mental tiredness during a long study session, especially when the material requires careful concentration.
primaryTranslation: 长时间学习时，定期休息能减少精神疲劳，尤其是学习材料需要高度专注的时候。

english: a person who is actively involved and included in something
primaryExample: Each participant received the same instructions, so differences in the results would not simply reflect a misunderstanding of the task.
primaryTranslation: 每位参与者都收到相同的说明，因此结果的差异不会仅仅反映对任务的误解。

english: ability to see things with your eyes
primaryExample: Her vision improved with the new glasses, allowing her to read the signs across the station without moving closer.
primaryTranslation: 戴上新眼镜后，她的视力改善了，不用走近就能看清车站另一边的标牌。

english: person's character; the way that a person usually acts
primaryExample: His cheerful personality helped new members feel comfortable, especially when they were nervous about joining their first group activity.
primaryTranslation: 他开朗的个性让新成员感到自在，尤其是在他们为首次参加集体活动而紧张的时候。

english: in a well-defined or clear manner; in particular
primaryExample: The instructions specifically ask visitors not to feed the birds, because unsuitable food can harm them and change their behaviour.
primaryTranslation: 说明明确要求游客不要喂鸟，因为不合适的食物会伤害鸟类，并改变它们的行为。

english: oily part of meat
primaryExample: She removed some fat from the meat before cooking it slowly with vegetables, herbs, and a small amount of stock.
primaryTranslation: 她先去掉肉上的一些脂肪，再用蔬菜、香草和少量高汤慢慢炖煮。

english: the act of going into some place
primaryExample: Entry to the building is controlled by a receptionist, who checks each visitor's name against a list provided in advance.
primaryTranslation: 进入大楼由接待员管理，接待员会根据事先提供的名单核查每位访客的姓名。

english: someone in the same group or situation; a boy or man
primaryExample: The young fellow sitting beside me offered to help when he noticed that I was struggling with my heavy bag.
primaryTranslation: 坐在我旁边的年轻人看到我拎沉重的包很吃力，便主动提出帮忙。

english: a basic substance produced by mixing elements
primaryExample: The teacher explained why the chemical must be stored in a labelled container rather than transferred into an ordinary drinks bottle.
primaryTranslation: 老师解释了为什么这种化学品必须存放在有标签的容器里，而不能倒进普通饮料瓶。

english: to catch and prevent a person/animal from being free
primaryExample: The wildlife team hoped to capture the injured bird safely so that it could receive treatment before being released.
primaryTranslation: 野生动物救助团队希望安全捕获受伤的鸟，为其治疗后再放归自然。

english: a small piece of advice; the end of something
primaryExample: The guide gave us a useful tip about visiting early, which helped us avoid the busiest part of the day.
primaryTranslation: 导游给了我们一条早点参观的实用建议，帮助我们避开一天中最拥挤的时段。

english: an amount of money taken off the usual price of something
primaryExample: The shop offered a discount on older models, although their quality was just as good as the latest designs.
primaryTranslation: 商店为较旧的型号提供折扣，尽管它们的质量和最新款一样好。

english: the time or place when something or someone is best, greatest, highest
primaryExample: We reached the mountain peak just as the clouds began to clear, revealing the valley far below us.
primaryTranslation: 我们到达山顶时，云层刚开始散开，显露出脚下远处的山谷。

english: a person in charge of a meeting
primaryExample: The chairman invited everyone to speak before asking the group to vote on the proposal for a new community garden.
primaryTranslation: 主席先邀请大家发言，再请全体成员对新建社区花园的提案进行投票。

english: an amount that is a part of a whole thing
primaryExample: A large proportion of the visitors arrived by train, which reduced the pressure on the village's limited parking spaces.
primaryTranslation: 很大一部分游客乘火车抵达，从而减轻了村庄有限停车位的压力。

english: the part of the head that you hear with
primaryExample: He held a hand behind his ear to hear the guide more clearly above the noise of passing traffic.
primaryTranslation: 他把一只手拢在耳后，以便在车辆经过的噪音中更清楚地听见导游的话。

english: to become impossible to see
primaryExample: The path seemed to disappear among the rocks, so we stopped to check the map before continuing any further.
primaryTranslation: 小路似乎消失在岩石之间，于是我们先停下来查地图，再继续前进。

english: to speak very loudly because you want to get their attention
primaryExample: There was no need to shout across the room once everyone had stopped talking and turned towards the speaker.
primaryTranslation: 大家都停止交谈并转向发言者后，就没有必要隔着房间大声喊话了。

english: outdoor area or garden next to a house
primaryExample: The children played in the yard while their parents prepared lunch inside, checking on them regularly through the open window.
primaryTranslation: 孩子们在院子里玩，父母在屋里准备午饭，并经常透过敞开的窗户查看他们。

english: happening frequently or without pause
primaryExample: The constant noise from the road made it difficult to concentrate, even after I closed the windows and moved my desk.
primaryTranslation: 马路上持续不断的噪音让人难以集中注意力，即使我关上窗户、挪了书桌也是如此。

english: in a way that is important or noticeable
primaryExample: The new timetable significantly reduced our waiting time, making public transport a more convenient choice for the daily journey.
primaryTranslation: 新时刻表显著缩短了我们的等候时间，让公共交通成为日常出行更方便的选择。

english: an area of land that is higher than the land around it but smaller than a mountain
primaryExample: We climbed the hill behind the village, where a small viewing platform offered a clear view of the surrounding countryside.
primaryTranslation: 我们爬上村后的山丘，那里的小观景台可以清楚地看到周围乡村。

primaryCollocations.english: at the top of the hill

english: large in size, amount, or effect
primaryExample: Repairing the old building required considerable effort, but the volunteers were determined to keep its original character and useful spaces.
primaryTranslation: 修复这栋老建筑需要付出很大努力，但志愿者决心保留它原有的特色和实用空间。

english: information about how to do or use something
primaryExample: The final instruction on the form explains where to send it once all the required details have been checked.
primaryTranslation: 表格上的最后一条说明解释了核查完所有必要信息后，应将表格寄往哪里。

english: ability to learn, think about, and understand things
primaryExample: The task required intelligence as well as patience, because the most obvious answer was not always the most useful one.
primaryTranslation: 这项任务既需要智力，也需要耐心，因为最明显的答案并不总是最有用的。

english: perfect; most suitable; best possible
primaryExample: The room was ideal for studying because it was quiet, well lit, and close enough to the library.
primaryTranslation: 这个房间非常适合学习，因为它安静、光线充足，而且离图书馆足够近。

english: ordinary people
primaryExample: The festival celebrated folk traditions through music, stories, and crafts that local families had passed down for many generations.
primaryTranslation: 节日通过音乐、故事和手工艺来庆祝当地家庭世代传承的民间传统。

english: with certainty; definitely
primaryExample: If we explain the reason for the delay clearly, people will surely understand why the original schedule had to change.
primaryTranslation: 如果清楚地解释延误原因，人们一定会理解原来的时间安排为什么必须改变。

english: to keep watch over something to protect it e.g., a bank
primaryExample: Two volunteers stayed behind to guard the equipment while the rest of the group went to collect the remaining supplies.
primaryTranslation: 两名志愿者留下来看守设备，其他组员则去取剩余的物资。

english: a small animal of the lion and tiger family with four legs and a tail that is kept as a pet
primaryExample: Our cat usually hides when visitors arrive, but it came out when the house finally became quiet again.
primaryTranslation: 家里来客人时，我们的猫通常会躲起来，但屋里终于重新安静后，它就出来了。

english: little, not very
primaryExample: The instructions were somewhat confusing at first, although the diagrams helped us understand what each part was supposed to do.
primaryTranslation: 这些说明起初有点令人困惑，不过图示帮助我们理解了每个零件的用途。

english: to put your lips against another's to show love
primaryExample: She paused to kiss her daughter goodbye before leaving for the airport, promising to call as soon as she arrived.
primaryTranslation: 她去机场前停下来亲吻女儿告别，并承诺一到达就打电话。

english: act of giving a formal talk about something
primaryExample: His presentation included photographs from the project, which made the results easier to understand than a long list of figures.
primaryTranslation: 他的演示展示了项目照片，比起一长串数字，这让结果更容易理解。

chinese: 1.（n）结点，关节；2.（adj）联合的，与他人合作的
english: 1. (n.) place where two things meet; 2. (adj.) done together
primaryExample: A damaged joint in the wooden frame allowed the whole structure to move whenever someone leaned against it.
primaryTranslation: 木框架的一处接合部损坏了，导致每当有人倚靠时，整个结构都会晃动。

english: to try to win something such as a race or game
primaryExample: Several local teams will compete in the tournament, which gives younger players a chance to gain experience under pressure.
primaryTranslation: 几支当地球队将参加锦标赛，让年轻球员有机会积累在压力下比赛的经验。

english: to get information by asking many people questions about a particular subject
primaryExample: The poll asked residents whether they supported longer library opening hours, including evenings when people had finished work.
primaryTranslation: 民意调查询问居民是否支持延长图书馆开放时间，包括人们下班后的晚间时段。

english: having little power; not strong; easy to break
primaryExample: The old chair had a weak leg, so we warned visitors not to use it until the repair was complete.
primaryTranslation: 旧椅子有一条不牢固的腿，所以我们提醒访客修好之前不要使用。

english: a strong belief that someone or something is honest and good
primaryExample: Her faith in the team remained strong, even after their first attempt to complete the challenge had ended in disappointment.
primaryTranslation: 即使团队第一次尝试完成挑战却以失望告终，她对团队的信心仍然坚定。

english: making something smaller; reducing something
primaryExample: A small reduction in energy use each week can lead to noticeable savings over the course of a year.
primaryTranslation: 每周少用一点能源，一年下来就能明显节省开支。

english: 1. (v) to arrange to use a room or table at a particular time; 2. (n) a store of something
primaryExample: We should reserve a table before travelling to the restaurant, since it becomes particularly busy on Friday evenings.
primaryTranslation: 去餐厅之前我们应该订桌，因为星期五晚上那里会特别忙。

english: saying something is wrong and should be changed
primaryExample: The hotel responded to our complaint by offering a quieter room away from the lift and the main entrance.
primaryTranslation: 酒店回应了我们的投诉，为我们安排了一间远离电梯和主入口、更安静的房间。

english: to make someone not interested in something
primaryExample: The speaker did not bore the audience with unnecessary detail, but used short stories to explain the main ideas.
primaryTranslation: 演讲者没有用不必要的细节让观众厌烦，而是用简短故事解释主要观点。

english: a special task or job that is given to a person or group
primaryExample: The team's mission was to restore the riverside path so that residents could walk safely between the two villages.
primaryTranslation: 团队的任务是修复河边小路，让居民能够在两个村庄之间安全步行。

english: in a way that is not known or certain
primaryExample: We somehow managed to fit all the equipment into the car, although there was hardly any room left for our bags.
primaryTranslation: 我们不知怎么地把所有设备都塞进了车里，不过几乎没有空间再放包了。

english: sound of a voice that shows emotion or meaning
primaryExample: Although her words were polite, the impatient tone of her voice made it clear that she wanted the discussion to end.
primaryTranslation: 虽然她的措辞很礼貌，但不耐烦的语气清楚表明她想结束讨论。

english: area of a town or city that people live in
primaryExample: The new playground gave families in the neighborhood somewhere safe to meet, especially during the long summer evenings.
primaryTranslation: 新游乐场为附近的家庭提供了安全的聚会地点，尤其适合夏季漫长的傍晚。

english: A person who is traveling in a vehicle
primaryExample: Each passenger was asked to keep the aisle clear so that staff could move safely through the train.
primaryTranslation: 每位乘客都被要求保持过道通畅，让工作人员能够安全地在火车里走动。

english: quality of being fair, equal, or just
primaryExample: The story explores whether justice is possible when people judge a stranger before hearing what really happened to him.
primaryTranslation: 这个故事探讨了：在人们尚未了解陌生人的真实遭遇就判断他时，正义是否可能实现。

english: distinct part or step in a process
primaryExample: During the first phase of the project, we collected ideas before deciding which changes would be most useful to residents.
primaryTranslation: 在项目的第一阶段，我们先收集想法，再决定哪些改变对居民最有用。

english: not thick; not wide in size
primaryExample: The book had thin pages that were easily damaged, so the librarian asked us to turn them carefully.
primaryTranslation: 这本书的纸页很薄，容易损坏，因此图书管理员请我们小心翻阅。

english: to do something very quickly
primaryExample: There is no need to rush through the final checks, since a small mistake could cause problems later.
primaryTranslation: 最后检查时没有必要匆忙行事，因为一个小错误可能会在以后造成问题。

english: suitable for serious, official, or important occasions
primaryExample: The invitation asked guests to wear formal clothes, although the evening itself was intended to feel relaxed and welcoming.
primaryTranslation: 邀请函要求客人穿正式服装，不过晚会本身希望营造轻松、友好的氛围。

english: set of beliefs about a god or gods
primaryExample: The course examines how religion has influenced art and architecture, while respecting the different beliefs held by students.
primaryTranslation: 课程探讨宗教如何影响艺术和建筑，同时尊重学生持有的不同信仰。

english: person or firm that pays people to work for them
primaryExample: Her employer agreed to adjust her working hours so that she could attend an evening course twice a week.
primaryTranslation: 雇主同意调整她的工作时间，让她每周能参加两次晚间课程。

english: to refuse to believe, accept, or consider
primaryExample: The committee may reject the proposal unless we explain more clearly how its benefits would justify the extra cost.
primaryTranslation: 如果我们不更清楚地说明收益如何值得额外投入，委员会可能会拒绝这项提案。

english: the second or last mentioned thing
primaryExample: We could repair the old printer or buy a new one, but the latter option would cost considerably more.
primaryTranslation: 我们可以修旧打印机，也可以买新的，但后一种选择会贵得多。

english: a flat dish used for eating or serving food
primaryExample: He carried the plate carefully across the crowded room, trying not to spill the sauce on anyone's clothes.
primaryTranslation: 他小心地端着盘子穿过拥挤的房间，尽量不把酱汁洒到别人的衣服上。

english: to make something illegal or not allowed
primaryExample: The council plans to ban cars from the narrow street during market hours, allowing pedestrians to move around more safely.
primaryTranslation: 委员会计划在集市开放时禁止汽车进入狭窄的街道，让行人更安全地通行。

english: to secretly take something that belongs to another
primaryExample: The story follows a boy who refuses to steal food, even when he is hungry and has no money.
primaryTranslation: 这个故事讲述一个男孩即使饥饿又没钱，也拒绝偷食物的经历。

english: to express opposition through action or words
primaryExample: Residents gathered to protest against the closure of their library, arguing that the nearest alternative was too far away.
primaryTranslation: 居民聚集起来抗议关闭图书馆，理由是最近的替代图书馆也太远了。

english: a written or printed list of topics or words in a particular order
primaryExample: The book's index helped me find the section on old bridges without having to read through every chapter.
primaryTranslation: 书后的索引帮助我找到介绍古桥的部分，而不必逐章翻阅。

english: feeling unhappy; wishing something hadn't happened
primaryExample: She felt sad when the course ended, because the weekly meetings had become an important part of her routine.
primaryTranslation: 课程结束时她很难过，因为每周的聚会已经成为她日常生活的重要部分。

english: often; regularly
primaryExample: The buses run frequently during the day, although evening passengers sometimes have to wait much longer between services.
primaryTranslation: 白天公交车班次很多，不过晚间乘客有时需要等待更长时间。

english: a perfectly round shape or a group arranged in that shape
primaryExample: The teacher asked everyone to sit in a circle so that each person could see and hear the others clearly.
primaryTranslation: 老师请大家围坐成一圈，让每个人都能清楚地看见并听见其他人。

english: doing things that help someone
primaryExample: The receptionist was particularly helpful when we needed to change our booking after the train arrived several hours late.
primaryTranslation: 火车晚点几个小时后，我们需要更改预订，接待员在这件事上帮了大忙。

english: to give an order; have control over others
primaryExample: The captain continued to command the rescue team calmly, even when the worsening weather forced them to change their original plan.
primaryTranslation: 即使天气恶化迫使他们改变原计划，队长仍然冷静地指挥救援队。

english: making you like them, as by being good-looking
primaryExample: The town became more attractive to visitors after the old harbour was cleaned and several walking routes were improved.
primaryTranslation: 老港口被清理、几条步行路线得到改善后，这座城镇对游客更有吸引力了。

english: having a physical or mental illness; not feeling well
primaryExample: He felt sick during the rough crossing, so he stayed on deck where the fresh air made him more comfortable.
primaryTranslation: 渡海时风浪很大，他觉得恶心，所以待在甲板上，那里新鲜的空气让他舒服些。

english: effect or feeling resulting from an experience
primaryExample: The guide's enthusiasm made a strong impression on us, even though we already knew quite a lot about the museum.
primaryTranslation: 尽管我们已经对博物馆了解不少，导游的热情仍给我们留下了深刻印象。

english: not being able to do something
primaryExample: We were unable to finish the repairs before dark, so we returned the next morning with better equipment.
primaryTranslation: 我们天黑前没能完成维修，于是第二天早晨带着更好的设备回来。

english: to say or do things that are meant to be funny
primaryExample: They often joke about getting lost on their first holiday together, although it seemed far less amusing at the time.
primaryTranslation: 他们经常拿第一次一起度假时迷路的事开玩笑，虽然当时可没觉得那么好笑。

english: the place where we see clouds above us
primaryExample: The sky became darker as we approached the coast, so we decided to finish our walk before the storm arrived.
primaryTranslation: 我们接近海岸时天空变暗了，所以决定在暴风雨来临前结束步行。

english: a tall post made of stone or wood used as a support in a building; one of two or more blocks of print that appear next to each other on a page
primaryExample: A thick stone column supported the roof above the entrance, where visitors waited until the museum was ready to open.
primaryTranslation: 一根粗大的石柱支撑着入口上方的屋顶，游客在那里等候博物馆开门。

english: operating by use of electricity; digital
primaryExample: The hotel sends an electronic confirmation after booking, which guests can show on their phones instead of printing it.
primaryTranslation: 酒店在预订后发送电子确认函，客人可以用手机出示，不必打印。

english: to make someone to do, believe, or accept something
primaryExample: The school did not want to impose extra costs on families, so it provided the materials needed for the workshop.
primaryTranslation: 学校不想给家庭增加额外费用，因此提供了工作坊所需的材料。

english: related to illegal activity; (n) a person who has done a crime
primaryExample: The documentary explained how criminal investigations depend on checking evidence carefully rather than simply accepting the first convincing story.
primaryTranslation: 这部纪录片解释了刑事调查如何依靠仔细核查证据，而不是直接接受第一个看似可信的说法。

english: other than or in addition to
primaryExample: Besides offering language classes, the centre organises social events where newcomers can meet local residents and practise speaking.
primaryTranslation: 除了提供语言课程，中心还组织社交活动，让新来者认识当地居民并练习口语。

english: in a correct or suitable way depending on the situation
primaryExample: The door would not close properly because a small piece of wood had become trapped underneath it.
primaryTranslation: 门关不好，因为一小块木头卡在了门底下。

english: very old; having lived a very long time ago
primaryExample: The guide explained how ancient builders moved heavy stones, although some details of their methods are still debated today.
primaryTranslation: 导游解释了古代建造者如何搬运巨石，不过他们使用的方法仍有一些细节存在争议。

english: land near the sea or ocean
primaryExample: We followed the coast for several kilometres before turning inland towards the village where we had booked a room.
primaryTranslation: 我们沿海岸走了几公里，然后转向内陆，前往预订了房间的村庄。

english: not well; sick
primaryExample: She had been ill for several days, so her colleagues offered to cover the meeting until she felt well enough to return.
primaryTranslation: 她病了好几天，因此同事们提出代她开会，直到她恢复到能回来工作。

english: to hit someone or something using your foot
primaryExample: The coach showed the children how to kick the ball accurately before asking them to practise with a partner.
primaryTranslation: 教练先教孩子们如何准确地踢球，再让他们两人一组练习。

english: very near in space or time; just next to
primaryExample: The teacher watched closely while the students used the equipment, ready to help if anyone became unsure about the next step.
primaryTranslation: 学生使用设备时，老师在旁边仔细观察，随时帮助不确定下一步操作的学生。

english: many things or people
primaryExample: The application asks for multiple examples of your experience, so prepare more than one situation that demonstrates your skills.
primaryTranslation: 申请要求提供多个经历实例，因此要准备不止一种情境来展示你的技能。

english: to give way to someone or something else
primaryExample: Drivers must yield to pedestrians at the crossing, even when there are no traffic lights controlling the flow of vehicles.
primaryTranslation: 即使没有红绿灯控制车流，司机也必须在人行横道处让行人先过。

english: by going through, by way of
primaryExample: We travelled to the island via the coastal town, where a regular ferry service connected with the morning train.
primaryTranslation: 我们经由海滨小镇前往岛上，那里的定期渡轮与早晨的火车衔接。

english: act or process of writing and passing laws
primaryExample: The proposed legislation would require clearer product labels so that customers could compare prices and ingredients more easily.
primaryTranslation: 拟议的法律将要求产品标签更加清楚，让顾客更容易比较价格和成分。

english: an area within a country or a state with its own local government
primaryExample: The county has several small villages, each of which depends on the same bus service to reach the nearest hospital.
