primaryTranslation: 这个郡有几个小村庄，每个村庄都依靠同一条公交线路前往最近的医院。

english: appearing or being different
primaryExample: The two sisters were quite unlike in character, although both enjoyed travelling and were curious about other people's lives.
primaryTranslation: 两姐妹的性格很不一样，不过她们都喜欢旅行，并对别人的生活充满好奇。

primaryCollocations.chinese: 与其他任何东西都不同

english: able to move from one place to another
primaryExample: The mobile library visits remote villages every fortnight, allowing residents to borrow books without making a long journey into town.
primaryTranslation: 流动图书馆每两周走访偏远村庄，让居民不用长途进城也能借书。

english: a person who helps another, usually as a job
primaryExample: The shop assistant checked the stockroom after the customer asked whether the same jacket was available in another size.
primaryTranslation: 顾客询问同款夹克是否有其他尺码后，店员到仓库进行了查看。

english: to start and carry out a plan or government policy; (n) tool
primaryExample: The school plans to implement the new timetable gradually, giving families enough time to adjust their travel arrangements.
primaryTranslation: 学校计划逐步实施新的时间表，给家庭足够的时间调整出行安排。

english: drawing showing information in a clear way
primaryExample: The chart showed how visitor numbers changed through the year, making the difference between summer and winter immediately clear.
primaryTranslation: 图表显示了一年中游客数量的变化，让夏季与冬季的差异一目了然。

english: to be associated or connected with
primaryExample: Please attach the receipt to your application so that the office can confirm how much you paid for the course.
primaryTranslation: 请在申请中附上收据，以便办公室确认你支付了多少课程费用。

english: any place of pain and suffering
primaryExample: In the novel, the abandoned town becomes a kind of hell for people who cannot find food, shelter, or safety.
primaryTranslation: 小说中，对那些找不到食物、住所或安全保障的人来说，这座废弃城镇成了一种地狱。

english: every place
primaryExample: After the strong wind, leaves were scattered everywhere, including inside the shed where the door had not been closed properly.
primaryTranslation: 大风过后，到处都是散落的树叶，连门没关好的棚屋里也有。

english: to suggest what should be done
primaryExample: The receptionist can advise you on the best way to reach the museum, depending on how much time you have.
primaryTranslation: 接待员能根据你有多少时间，建议你选择最合适的方式去博物馆。

english: all the people who live in a house; a family
primaryExample: Each household received a leaflet explaining how to separate recyclable materials before the new collection service began operating.
primaryTranslation: 在新的收集服务开始前，每户家庭都收到了一份说明如何分类可回收物的传单。

english: to accept that something is true
primaryExample: The manager was willing to acknowledge the mistake and explain what the company would do to prevent it happening again.
primaryTranslation: 经理愿意承认错误，并解释公司将采取什么措施防止同样的事再次发生。

english: to give something to someone because of their good work
primaryExample: The organisers wanted to reward volunteers for their efforts, so they arranged a special evening at the end of the festival.
primaryTranslation: 组织者想感谢志愿者的付出，因此在节日结束时为他们安排了一个特别的晚会。

english: the direction where the sun rises
primaryExample: The garden faces east, which means the kitchen receives plenty of natural light during the early part of the morning.
primaryTranslation: 花园朝东，因此早晨较早的时候，厨房能照到充足的自然光。

english: something people wear to cover their heads for fashion or protection
primaryExample: She packed a wide hat for the walking holiday, knowing that there would be little shade along the coastal path.
primaryTranslation: 她知道沿海步道上几乎没有树荫，因此为徒步假期准备了一顶宽檐帽。

chinese: 学院的，学术的；（n）学者，大学教师
english: related to education or school; (n) educator who works at a college or university
primaryExample: The course combines academic study with practical experience, allowing students to test ideas they have discussed in the classroom.
primaryTranslation: 课程把学术学习与实践经验结合起来，让学生检验在课堂上讨论过的想法。

english: a person who can vote in an election
primaryExample: Each voter received information about the candidates before entering the room where the local election was taking place.
primaryTranslation: 每位选民进入举行地方选举的房间前，都收到了候选人的相关信息。

english: at or during the same time; in the meantime
primaryExample: The adults prepared the picnic; meanwhile, the children checked the map and chose a suitable place beside the river.
primaryTranslation: 大人们准备野餐，与此同时，孩子们查看地图，在河边选了一处合适的地点。

english: in addition to what has been said
primaryExample: The new building uses less energy than the old one; furthermore, it has better access for people with limited mobility.
primaryTranslation: 新楼比旧楼更节能，而且为行动不便的人提供了更好的通行条件。

english: to say that someone has done something bad or wrong
primaryExample: You should not accuse someone of taking your belongings until you have checked whether they were moved for a good reason.
primaryTranslation: 指责别人拿了你的物品之前，应先核查物品是否因合理原因被挪走。

english: related to science
primaryExample: The students learned that a scientific explanation should be supported by evidence that other people can examine and test.
primaryTranslation: 学生们学到，科学解释应当有证据支持，而且这些证据能被其他人检查和验证。

english: money paid to workers for the hours they worked
primaryExample: The advertised wage seemed reasonable, but she asked how many hours she would be expected to work each week.
primaryTranslation: 广告上给出的工资似乎合理，但她问清楚了每周预计要工作多少小时。

english: a time when you are not in a place where you should be
primaryExample: In the teacher's absence, the assistant explained the task and made sure that every student had the materials they needed.
primaryTranslation: 老师不在时，助教解释了任务，并确保每位学生都有所需的材料。

english: to build or create something
primaryExample: The volunteers helped construct a simple shelter beside the sports field so that spectators could stay dry during matches.
primaryTranslation: 志愿者帮助在运动场旁搭建了一个简易遮雨棚，让观众在比赛时保持干爽。

english: to say an opinion or make a comment about something
primaryExample: Several visitors remark on how peaceful the village feels, even though it is only a short train journey from the city.
primaryTranslation: 几位游客都提到这个村庄多么宁静，尽管从城市乘火车很快就能到达。

english: liquid or pills used to treat illness or pain; the study of treating illness or pain
primaryExample: The nurse explained how to store the medicine safely, away from heat and out of the reach of young children.
primaryTranslation: 护士解释了如何安全存放药物，要避开高温，并放在幼儿够不到的地方。

english: a teacher of high rank in a university or college
primaryExample: The professor encouraged students to question the evidence rather than repeat an argument simply because it appeared in a textbook.
primaryTranslation: 教授鼓励学生质疑证据，而不是因为某个论点出现在教科书里就照搬。

english: not common or usual
primaryExample: It is rare to find such a quiet beach near the city, especially during the busiest weeks of the summer.
primaryTranslation: 在城市附近找到这样安静的海滩很少见，尤其是在夏季最繁忙的几个星期。

english: plan, aim, or purpose
primaryExample: My intention was to clarify the schedule, not to suggest that anyone had deliberately caused the delay in our work.
primaryTranslation: 我的本意是说清楚时间安排，而不是暗示有人故意拖延了我们的工作。

english: a group of twelve people or things
primaryExample: We bought a dozen rolls from the bakery, which was enough to make lunch for everyone taking part in the trip.
primaryTranslation: 我们从面包店买了十二个面包卷，足够给所有参加旅行的人做午餐。

english: an official agreement that ends an argument or fight between people or groups
primaryExample: After weeks of discussion, both sides reached a settlement that allowed the community centre to remain open under new management.
primaryTranslation: 经过数周讨论，双方达成了协议，让社区中心在新的管理下继续开放。

english: a space between two things
primaryExample: There was a small gap beneath the door, allowing cold air to enter even when the room was otherwise warm.
primaryTranslation: 门下有一道小缝，即使屋里其他地方暖和，冷空气也能钻进来。

english: by or among a large number of people
primaryExample: The book is widely used in language classes because its examples encourage students to discuss situations from their own lives.
primaryTranslation: 这本书广泛用于语言课，因为书中的例子鼓励学生讨论自身生活中的情境。

english: lowest number or amount that is possible
primaryExample: The course requires a minimum of six participants, so it cannot begin until two more people have registered.
primaryTranslation: 这门课程至少需要六人参加，因此还要再有两人报名才能开课。

english: in or toward the north
primaryExample: The northern part of the island is quieter, with fewer hotels and several walking routes that pass through small fishing villages.
primaryTranslation: 岛的北部更安静，酒店较少，还有几条穿过小渔村的步行路线。

english: land that a person owns
primaryExample: The old estate includes farmland and woodland, much of which is now open to visitors who follow the marked paths.
primaryTranslation: 这片古老庄园包括农田和林地，其中许多地方如今向沿标记路线行走的访客开放。

english: in an equal, similar, or identical way
primaryExample: The teacher divided the materials equally among the groups so that no team would have an advantage during the activity.
primaryTranslation: 老师把材料平均分给各组，让任何一组都不会在活动中占有优势。

english: to show something that is usually hidden, covered, or protected
primaryExample: The investigation helped expose serious problems in the booking system, which had remained hidden because customers rarely received clear explanations.
primaryTranslation: 调查帮助揭露了预订系统的严重问题，这些问题一直隐藏着，因为顾客很少得到明确解释。

english: living; not dead
primaryExample: The missing plant was still alive, although it had received very little water while we were away from home.
primaryTranslation: 那株被遗忘的植物仍然活着，尽管我们不在家期间，它几乎没得到浇水。

english: to close something
primaryExample: Please shut the window before you leave, as strong wind may blow rain onto the papers on my desk.
primaryTranslation: 离开前请关上窗户，因为大风可能把雨吹到我桌上的文件上。

english: a win in a war, game, or competition
primaryExample: Their victory was especially satisfying because the team had worked hard to improve after losing the same competition the previous year.
primaryTranslation: 他们的胜利格外令人满意，因为球队在去年同一比赛失利后，一直努力提高。

english: to find an answer or way to handle a problem
primaryExample: We arranged a meeting to resolve the problem before it caused further delays to the work being done by other teams.
primaryTranslation: 我们安排了一次会议来解决问题，以免进一步耽误其他团队正在进行的工作。

english: a person whose job is to give opinions about books, movies, or other forms of art
primaryExample: The critic praised the actors' performances but argued that the final scene failed to explain the main character's decision clearly.
primaryTranslation: 评论家赞扬了演员的表演，但认为最后一幕没有清楚解释主角的决定。

english: having the ability to change or vary
primaryExample: The weather is highly variable in the mountains, so walkers should be prepared for conditions to change within a few hours.
primaryTranslation: 山区天气变化很大，因此徒步者应该准备好应对几小时内发生的天气变化。

english: huge; very big; very large
primaryExample: The project required an enormous amount of patience, particularly when the team had to repeat work that had already been completed.
primaryTranslation: 这个项目需要极大的耐心，尤其是在团队不得不重做已经完成的工作时。

english: tasting like sugar; containing sugar
primaryExample: The fruit was naturally sweet, so we decided not to add sugar when preparing the dessert for our guests.
primaryTranslation: 水果本身很甜，因此为客人制作甜点时，我们决定不再加糖。

english: lasting forever; not temporary or changing
primaryExample: The exhibition was so successful that the museum decided to give it a permanent place rather than remove it after summer.
primaryTranslation: 展览非常成功，因此博物馆决定永久保留，而不是在夏天过后撤展。

english: a feeling such as sadness, anger, or love
primaryExample: Her voice carried a strong emotion when she described returning to the town where she had spent her childhood.
primaryTranslation: 她描述重返童年生活过的城镇时，声音里流露出强烈的情感。

english: to follow and try to catch something; to try to get something
primaryExample: She decided to pursue a career in design after discovering that she enjoyed solving practical problems through drawing and making things.
primaryTranslation: 发现自己喜欢通过绘画和制作物品解决实际问题后，她决定从事设计工作。

english: greater in height than average
primaryExample: The tall trees along the path provided welcome shade, although their roots sometimes made the ground difficult to walk on.
primaryTranslation: 路旁的高树带来了宜人的树荫，尽管树根有时使地面变得难走。

english: to strongly persuade someone to do something
primaryExample: The organiser will urge people to book early, because the smaller rooms usually fill up several weeks before the event.
primaryTranslation: 组织者会力劝大家尽早预订，因为较小的房间通常在活动开始前几周就会订满。

english: someone who wants to harm another
primaryExample: The two characters begin the story as enemies, but working towards the same goal gradually changes how they see each other.
primaryTranslation: 故事开始时两个角色是敌人，但朝共同目标努力逐渐改变了他们对彼此的看法。

english: to officially choose a person for a job, position
primaryExample: The committee will appoint a new manager after interviewing candidates who have experience running similar projects in other towns.
primaryTranslation: 委员会将面试在其他城镇负责过类似项目的候选人，然后任命一位新经理。

english: the white liquid produced by females to feed their babies
primaryExample: We kept the milk in a cool bag during the journey because there was no refrigerator at the campsite.
primaryTranslation: 旅途中我们把牛奶放在保冷袋里，因为营地没有冰箱。

english: the natural ability of a person to do something well
primaryExample: Her talent for explaining difficult ideas became clear when the younger students began asking her to help with their homework.
primaryTranslation: 低年级学生开始请她辅导作业时，她解释复杂概念的天赋显现了出来。

english: to use your nose to sense something
primaryExample: You could smell the fresh bread from the street, which made it difficult to walk past the bakery without stopping.
primaryTranslation: 在街上就能闻到新鲜面包的香味，让人很难路过面包店而不停下来。

english: happening or coming earlier in time
primaryExample: No prior experience is necessary for the course, because the tutor introduces each skill before asking participants to practise it.
primaryTranslation: 参加课程不需要先前经验，因为导师会先介绍每项技能，再让学员练习。

english: something that is important and must be done before other things
primaryExample: Improving access to the library became a priority after residents explained how difficult the steps were for older visitors.
primaryTranslation: 居民说明台阶给年长访客带来的困难后，改善图书馆通行条件成了优先事项。

english: connected to the internet
primaryExample: The course is available online, allowing people who live far from the college to participate without making long journeys.
primaryTranslation: 这门课程可以在线学习，让远离学院的人不用长途出行也能参加。

english: a group of words that forms a unit and expresses a single meaning
primaryExample: The teacher asked us to choose a phrase from the article and explain how its meaning changed in a different context.
primaryTranslation: 老师让我们从文章中选一个短语，解释它在不同语境下意思如何变化。

chinese: （飞机，宇宙飞船或船舶的）驾驶员
english: a person who controls an airplane, spacecraft, or boat
primaryExample: The pilot explained that strong winds might delay our landing, although the aircraft had enough fuel to wait safely.
primaryTranslation: 飞行员解释说，强风可能推迟降落，不过飞机有足够燃料安全等候。

english: in a good situation or condition; not likely to change
primaryExample: The table became stable again after we replaced the damaged leg, so it could safely hold the heavy equipment.
primaryTranslation: 更换损坏的桌腿后，桌子重新稳固了，可以安全地承载重型设备。

english: only, simply, or nothing more than
primaryExample: He was not merely asking for more money; he wanted the organisation to explain how the existing budget had been used.
primaryTranslation: 他不只是在要求更多经费，还想让机构解释现有预算的使用情况。

english: a formal agreement or statement decided by a group of people
primaryExample: The committee passed a resolution to protect the old library, even though several members disagreed about how to fund the repairs.
primaryTranslation: 尽管几位成员对维修资金来源有分歧，委员会仍通过了一项保护旧图书馆的决议。

english: to give and exchange information
primaryExample: The team learned to communicate more clearly after discovering that small misunderstandings had caused several avoidable delays in their work.
primaryTranslation: 发现小误会导致工作中几次本可避免的延误后，团队学会了更清楚地沟通。

english: physical or emotional harm or damage that a person experiences
primaryExample: A minor injury kept him away from training for a week, although he still attended matches to support his teammates.
primaryTranslation: 一处轻伤让他一周无法训练，不过他仍去看比赛，为队友加油。

english: being very large in size or amount
primaryExample: The museum holds a vast collection of photographs, many of which show places that have changed almost beyond recognition.
primaryTranslation: 博物馆收藏了大量照片，其中许多拍摄的地方已经变化得几乎认不出来。

english: an event at which an object or group of objects is shown to the public
primaryExample: The exhibition brought together work by local artists, giving visitors a chance to compare different ways of showing the same landscape.
primaryTranslation: 展览汇集了当地艺术家的作品，让观众有机会比较表现同一景观的不同方法。

english: a company making or growing a certain product
primaryExample: The local producer sells most of its cheese directly to shops, which helps keep transport distances short and products fresh.
primaryTranslation: 当地生产商把大部分奶酪直接卖给商店，这有助于缩短运输距离、保持产品新鲜。

english: having to do with a particular area
primaryExample: The regional bus service connects small villages with the town, where residents can reach schools, shops, and the hospital.
primaryTranslation: 区域公交服务把小村庄与城镇连接起来，居民能在那里前往学校、商店和医院。

english: done without delay; straight away
primaryExample: The problem required immediate attention because even a short delay could damage the equipment and interrupt the whole project.
primaryTranslation: 这个问题需要立即处理，因为即使短暂延误也可能损坏设备，中断整个项目。

english: something that happens, especially if it is bad or unusual
primaryExample: The manager recorded the incident carefully, including what had happened before the alarm and how the staff had responded.
primaryTranslation: 经理仔细记录了这一事件，包括警报前发生的情况，以及员工如何作出回应。

english: the time when you are a child
primaryExample: Her memories of childhood included long afternoons in the garden, where her grandparents taught her the names of common birds.
primaryTranslation: 她的童年回忆包括在花园里度过的漫长下午，祖父母在那里教她认识常见鸟类。

english: a piece of writing or plan that is not yet finished
primaryExample: Please read the first draft before our meeting, so that we can spend our time discussing the parts that need improvement.
primaryTranslation: 开会前请阅读初稿，让我们把时间用来讨论需要改进的部分。

english: to slide out of position or fall to the ground by accident
primaryExample: Be careful not to slip on the wet steps, especially where leaves have collected near the bottom of the path.
primaryTranslation: 小心别在湿台阶上滑倒，尤其是小路底端附近积了树叶的地方。

english: to go somewhere with someone
primaryExample: A guide will accompany the group through the older part of the building, where visitors cannot explore on their own.
primaryTranslation: 一位导游将陪同参观团经过大楼的老旧部分，访客不能在那里自行游览。

english: someone who is active in politics
primaryExample: The politician promised to listen to local concerns before announcing whether she would support the proposed changes to public transport.
primaryTranslation: 这位政治家承诺先倾听当地居民的担忧，再宣布是否支持拟议的公共交通改革。

english: having a strong feeling about something that you dislike very much
primaryExample: She was angry about the delay, but she waited until she felt calmer before discussing it with the manager.
primaryTranslation: 她对延误很生气，但等到平静些后，才和经理讨论这件事。

english: to hit something to get people's attention
primaryExample: Please knock before entering the office, because someone may be having a private conversation with a member of staff.
primaryTranslation: 进入办公室前请先敲门，因为里面可能有人正在与工作人员私下交谈。

english: a small object made by a plant from which a new plant can grow; the beginning of something
primaryExample: The children planted a seed in each pot, then recorded how the plants changed when they received different amounts of light.
primaryTranslation: 孩子们在每个花盆里种下一粒种子，再记录光照量不同时植物的变化。

english: money an employee is paid each year
primaryExample: She accepted a slightly lower salary because the new job offered better training and a much shorter journey from home.
primaryTranslation: 她接受了略低的薪水，因为新工作提供更好的培训，而且通勤距离短得多。

english: to explain with examples, to make it easier to understand
primaryExample: The teacher used a simple map to illustrate how the river had influenced the growth of the town over time.
primaryTranslation: 老师用一张简单的地图，说明这条河如何随着时间推移影响了城镇的发展。

english: to suggest something, without saying it directly
primaryExample: Her message did not imply that the project was finished; it simply confirmed that the first stage had been approved.
primaryTranslation: 她的信息并不是暗示项目已完成，而只是确认第一阶段已经获批。

english: the first meal of the day
primaryExample: We ate breakfast earlier than usual so that we could catch the first bus and avoid the busiest walking paths.
primaryTranslation: 我们比平时更早吃早餐，以便赶上首班公交车，避开最拥挤的步道。

english: continuing for a limited time, not permanent
primaryExample: The family found temporary accommodation near the school while repairs were carried out on the roof of their own home.
primaryTranslation: 这家人在学校附近找到了临时住所，等待自己家的屋顶维修完成。

english: open to new ideas; believing government should actively support social needs
primaryExample: Her parents held liberal views about education, encouraging her to explore different subjects before choosing a particular career path.
primaryTranslation: 她的父母教育观念开明，鼓励她先探索不同学科，再选择具体的职业方向。

english: a large area of water surrounded by land
primaryExample: A path runs around the lake, giving visitors several places to stop and watch the birds without disturbing them.
primaryTranslation: 一条小路环绕湖泊，为访客提供了几处可以停下来观察鸟类而不打扰它们的地方。

english: to get the necessary skill or knowledge to do a particular job or activity
primaryExample: She hopes the course will help her qualify as an instructor, allowing her to teach activities she has enjoyed for years.
primaryTranslation: 她希望这门课程能帮助她获得教练资格，从而教授自己喜欢多年的活动。

english: wanting to win or to be better than others
primaryExample: He became less competitive after learning that the club valued teamwork and regular participation more than winning every match.
primaryTranslation: 得知俱乐部更重视合作和经常参与，而非赢下每场比赛后，他不再那么争强好胜。

english: based on truth or fact or reality
primaryExample: The village felt truly peaceful once the daytime visitors had left and only the sound of the river remained.
primaryTranslation: 白天的游客离开后，村里只剩下河水声，这时才显得真正宁静。

english: what you say when you meet someone; hello
primaryExample: She said hi to the new neighbours before asking whether they needed any help carrying boxes into their flat.
primaryTranslation: 她先向新邻居打了招呼，然后问他们是否需要帮忙把箱子搬进公寓。

english: color of lemons or the sun
primaryExample: We chose yellow curtains for the small kitchen because they made the room feel warmer on cloudy winter mornings.
primaryTranslation: 我们给小厨房选了黄色窗帘，因为它们让阴沉冬日早晨的房间显得更温暖。

english: the usual way of behaving; something often repeated
primaryExample: He developed the habit of writing a short plan each evening, which made the following morning feel much less rushed.
primaryTranslation: 他养成了每天晚上写简短计划的习惯，让第二天早晨不再那么匆忙。

english: a flat round object
primaryExample: The display showed how a spinning disk can appear almost still when its speed matches the flashing light above it.
primaryTranslation: 演示展示了旋转圆盘的速度与上方闪光灯匹配时，圆盘如何看起来几乎静止。

english: the central part of a fruit that contains the seeds; the central part of something
primaryExample: Remove the apple's core before cutting the fruit into small pieces, as the seeds and harder centre are not needed.
primaryTranslation: 把苹果切成小块前先去核，因为不需要种子和较硬的中心部分。

english: related to deep feelings
primaryExample: The final scene was emotional because the characters finally understood what their long separation had meant to each other.
primaryTranslation: 最后一幕令人动情，因为角色们终于明白，多年的分离对彼此意味着什么。

english: a machine that can fly
primaryExample: The aircraft remained on the ground while engineers checked a warning light that had appeared before the scheduled departure.
primaryTranslation: 原定起飞前出现一盏警示灯，因此飞机留在地面，等待工程师检查。

english: the type of person you really are
primaryExample: The story shows how a change of circumstances can reveal a person's true self more clearly than their everyday behaviour.
primaryTranslation: 这个故事展示了环境的改变如何比日常行为更清楚地显露一个人的真实自我。

english: a type of hardy material that is usually hard and shiny that can be used to make things, such as iron, gold, or steel
primaryExample: The metal frame was heavier than the wooden one, but it was better suited to supporting the large shelves.
primaryTranslation: 金属框架比木框架更重，但更适合支撑大型架子。

english: state of being present, alive, or real
primaryExample: The discovery confirmed the existence of an earlier settlement, although researchers still had many questions about the people who lived there.
primaryTranslation: 这一发现证实了更早聚居地的存在，不过研究者对曾住在那里的人仍有很多疑问。

english: hard pieces of a body that form the frame of an animal
primaryExample: The museum displayed a large bone from an ancient animal, alongside a drawing showing where it fitted into the body.
primaryTranslation: 博物馆展示了一块古代动物的大骨头，旁边配有示意图，说明它在身体中的位置。

english: a rectangular piece of wood, metal, etc., that is a part of something bigger; a group of people who discuss something
primaryExample: The builder removed a wooden panel to reach the pipes, then replaced it carefully once the repair was finished.
primaryTranslation: 工人拆下一块木板以便接近管道，维修完成后又小心地把它装回原处。

english: main; most important; best quality
primaryExample: The prime reason for the change was to make the service more reliable, rather than to attract a larger number of customers.
primaryTranslation: 这次调整的主要原因是提高服务可靠性，而不是吸引更多顾客。

english: the time you arranged to meet someone or do something
primaryExample: I made an appointment with the adviser so that we could discuss my plans without interruptions from the busy reception area.
primaryTranslation: 我与顾问约好了时间，以便在不受繁忙接待区干扰的情况下讨论我的计划。

english: to stress the items that are important
primaryExample: The coach tried to emphasize the importance of regular practice rather than letting the children focus only on winning competitions.
primaryTranslation: 教练努力强调规律练习的重要性，而不是让孩子们只关注赢得比赛。

english: largest or greatest
primaryExample: The room can hold a maximum of twenty people, so we will need another space if more participants register.
primaryTranslation: 这个房间最多能容纳二十人，因此如果有更多人报名，就需要另找场地。

english: in a way that produces the result you want
primaryExample: The team worked more effectively once everyone understood which tasks they were responsible for and when those tasks had to be finished.
primaryTranslation: 当每个人都清楚自己的任务及截止时间后，团队的工作更有效率了。

english: in or to another or different place
primaryExample: The cafe was full, so we decided to look elsewhere rather than wait outside in the cold for a table.
primaryTranslation: 咖啡馆满了，所以我们决定去别处找，而不是在外面的寒风里等桌位。

english: to take the trouble to do something
primaryExample: I did not bother to print the map because I knew the route well enough to find the building without it.
primaryTranslation: 我没有费心打印地图，因为我足够熟悉路线，不用地图也能找到那栋楼。

english: ability to decide or act upon things yourself without depending on someone else
primaryExample: She showed initiative by contacting the supplier herself, rather than waiting for someone else to notice that the delivery was late.
primaryTranslation: 她主动联系了供应商，而没有等别人发现交货已经延误。

english: having a thin edge or point that is able to cut
primaryExample: Keep the sharp knife away from the edge of the table, where someone could knock it onto the floor accidentally.
primaryTranslation: 把锋利的刀放得离桌边远一点，以免有人不小心把它碰到地上。

english: the type of food that a person or animal usually eats
primaryExample: His usual diet includes plenty of vegetables, although he finds it harder to prepare balanced meals when travelling for work.
primaryTranslation: 他平常的饮食包含大量蔬菜，不过出差时，他觉得准备均衡的饭菜更困难。

english: a movement; the way something moves
primaryExample: The slow motion of the boat made it easier to observe the birds without disturbing them along the riverbank.
primaryTranslation: 船缓慢移动，让我们更容易观察河岸边的鸟类，而不打扰它们。

english: color between black and white
primaryExample: The gray clouds gradually covered the hills, warning us that the clear weather might not last until the end of our walk.
primaryTranslation: 灰云渐渐遮住山丘，提醒我们晴朗天气可能无法持续到徒步结束。

english: a very common, light, strong material that can be formed into many different shapes and is made by a chemical process
primaryExample: We replaced several plastic containers with reusable glass jars, although we kept the lighter ones for carrying food on trips.
primaryTranslation: 我们把几个塑料容器换成可重复使用的玻璃罐，不过保留了较轻的容器供旅行携带食物。

english: to make more difficult
primaryExample: Adding too many optional features could complicate the design and make the product harder for new users to understand.
primaryTranslation: 加入太多可选功能可能使设计复杂化，让新用户更难理解产品。

english: the teaching of self-control through instruction and practice
primaryExample: Learning an instrument requires discipline, because progress depends on regular practice even when the same exercise no longer feels exciting.
primaryTranslation: 学习乐器需要自律，因为即使同样的练习不再令人兴奋，进步仍取决于坚持练习。

english: to not meet the expectations of others or yourself
primaryExample: We did not want to disappoint the visitors, so we found an alternative activity when the outdoor performance was cancelled.
primaryTranslation: 户外演出取消后，我们不想让游客失望，因此找了一个替代活动。

english: a person who manages you, or is in charge of you at work
primaryExample: Her boss encouraged her to explain the problem early, rather than wait until it had become difficult for the whole team.
primaryTranslation: 老板鼓励她及早说明问题，而不是等到它给整个团队造成困难。

english: something you believe to be so, but aren't sure of
primaryExample: Our plan was based on the assumption that the equipment would arrive before the first group of visitors came.
primaryTranslation: 我们的计划建立在这样的假设上：设备会在第一批游客到达之前送到。

english: to become hard because of very cold temperatures
primaryExample: The water may freeze overnight if the temperature continues to fall, so we moved the small plants into the greenhouse.
primaryTranslation: 如果气温继续下降，水可能在夜里结冰，所以我们把小植物搬进了温室。

english: very great in degree
primaryExample: The walkers turned back because extreme weather had made the path unsafe, even for people with plenty of experience.
primaryTranslation: 徒步者折返了，因为极端天气使小路变得不安全，即使经验丰富的人也不例外。

english: a long, narrow area that connects one place to another
primaryExample: A narrow passage connected the kitchen with the courtyard, allowing staff to carry meals outside without crossing the main dining room.
primaryTranslation: 一条狭窄的通道连接着厨房和庭院，让员工不用穿过主餐厅就能把饭菜端到外面。

english: an opinion that people have about someone or something based on the past
primaryExample: The restaurant built a good reputation by serving fresh local food and responding politely whenever customers suggested improvements.
primaryTranslation: 这家餐厅提供新鲜的本地食物，并礼貌回应顾客的改进建议，由此建立了良好声誉。

english: out of a place; forward in time, place, or way
primaryExample: The little boat moved back and forth beside the jetty as passengers waited for the river to become calmer.
primaryTranslation: 乘客们等待河面平静些的时候，小船在码头旁来回晃动。

english: a formal discussion to reach an agreement
primaryExample: The negotiation continued for several weeks because both sides wanted an agreement that would remain workable when circumstances changed.
primaryTranslation: 谈判持续了几个星期，因为双方都希望达成一份在情况变化后仍然可行的协议。

english: a part or a set of parts of a machine that has a particular function
primaryExample: The locking mechanism was damaged, so the window could not remain securely closed when a strong wind blew against it.
primaryTranslation: 锁闭装置损坏了，因此强风吹向窗户时，窗户无法牢固地保持关闭。

english: clothing worn outside over your normal clothes
primaryExample: She carried a coat even though the morning was warm, knowing that evenings near the coast could become surprisingly cold.
primaryTranslation: 虽然早晨很暖和，她还是带了外套，因为知道海边晚上可能会冷得出乎意料。

english: a system of government in which the people of a country can vote to elect who will govern them
primaryExample: The lesson explored how democracy allows people to influence public decisions, while also requiring them to respect different opinions.
primaryTranslation: 课堂探讨了民主如何让人们影响公共决策，同时也要求人们尊重不同意见。

english: small cloth bag sewn into clothing to hold things
primaryExample: He kept the address in his coat pocket so that he could check it quickly without opening his heavy bag.
primaryTranslation: 他把地址放在外套口袋里，这样不用打开沉重的包就能迅速查看。

english: fortunate; having good things happen to you
primaryExample: We were lucky to find a room near the station, especially since most hotels had been booked for the festival.
primaryTranslation: 我们很幸运，在车站附近找到了一间房，尤其是大多数酒店都已因节日订满。

english: to hit something hard enough to cause serious damage
primaryExample: The loose branch could crash through the window if another strong gust pushed it towards the side of the building.
primaryTranslation: 如果再来一阵强风把松动的树枝推向楼的一侧，它可能撞破窗户。

english: careful watching and listening; remark or comment on something you have noticed
primaryExample: Careful observation helped the students notice that the plant near the window grew differently from the one kept in shade.
primaryTranslation: 仔细观察帮助学生发现，窗边的植物与放在阴处的那株长得不同。

english: the muscles and soft parts of animals or birds that is eaten as food
primaryExample: The recipe suggests cooking the meat slowly with vegetables, which allows the flavours to develop without letting the mixture become dry.
primaryTranslation: 食谱建议把肉和蔬菜慢慢炖煮，让味道充分融合，同时不让食材变干。

english: the ability to direct all your effort and attention on the one thing you are doing and nothing else
primaryExample: The task required complete concentration, so she chose to work in a quiet room where messages and conversations would not interrupt her.
primaryTranslation: 这项任务需要全神贯注，因此她选择在安静的房间工作，避免消息和谈话打扰。

english: possible effects or results from an action or event
primaryExample: The committee discussed the possible implication of closing the library, particularly for residents who had no internet access at home.
primaryTranslation: 委员会讨论了关闭图书馆可能带来的影响，尤其关注家中无法上网的居民。

english: to get the appropriate reward or punishment for the way you behaved or something you did
primaryExample: The volunteers deserve recognition for their efforts, especially those who continued helping long after the main event had finished.
primaryTranslation: 志愿者的付出值得认可，尤其是那些在主要活动结束很久后仍继续帮忙的人。

english: different from what is ordinary or normal in a way that attracts attention; not usual
primaryExample: It was unusual to see the harbour so quiet, until we learned that bad weather had cancelled all the morning ferries.
primaryTranslation: 港口如此安静很不寻常，直到我们得知恶劣天气导致早上的渡轮全部取消。

english: to protect against an attack
primaryExample: The local team worked hard to defend their lead, although their opponents created several good chances in the final minutes.
primaryTranslation: 当地球队努力保住领先优势，尽管对手在最后几分钟创造了几次好机会。

english: something popular or famous for a long time and is considered one of the best of its kind
primaryExample: The novel became a classic because its questions about friendship and responsibility continued to interest readers from many different generations.
primaryTranslation: 这部小说成了经典，因为其中关于友谊和责任的问题持续吸引着不同世代的读者。

english: the male ruler of a country that has a royal family
primaryExample: The king appears in several local stories, although historians disagree about how closely those stories reflect what actually happened.
primaryTranslation: 国王出现在几个当地传说中，不过历史学家对这些故事在多大程度上反映事实存在分歧。
